questions.stem: Which of the following threat actors is the most likely to be hired by a foreign government to attack critical systems located in other countries?
questions.explanation: Kata “disewa” mengarah ke kelompok kriminal yang menawarkan jasa. Nation-state lebih tepat jika pemerintah sendiri menjadi pelaku atau sponsor utama. Hacktivist punya motif ideologis.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to add extra complexity before using a one-way data transformation algorithm?
questions.explanation: Salt unik ditambahkan sebelum password di-hash agar password sama tidak menghasilkan hash yang sama. Key stretching menambah biaya komputasi; masking menyembunyikan tampilan; steganografi menyembunyikan keberadaan pesan.

questions.stem: An employee clicked a link in an email from a payment website that asked the employee to update contact information. The employee entered the log-in information but received a “page not found” error message. Which of the following types of social engineering attacks occurred
questions.explanation: Email mengarahkan korban ke halaman yang meminta login. Itu phishing; peniruan merek adalah taktiknya. Typosquatting membutuhkan domain mirip dengan ejaan berbeda.

questions.stem: An enterprise is trying to limit outbound DNS traffic originating from its internal network. Outbound DNS requests will only be allowed from one device with the IP address 10.50.10.25. Which of the following firewall ACLs will accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation: Tujuan aturan adalah mengizinkan DNS outbound hanya dari 10.50.10.25. D menempatkan permit untuk sumber 10.50.10.25/32 ke semua tujuan pada port 53, disusul deny untuk sumber lain. A dan C mengizinkan semua sumber terlebih dahulu sehingga deny di bawahnya tidak membatasi trafik yang sudah cocok. B membatasi alamat tujuan, bukan sumber. Dalam notasi soal, /32 berarti satu alamat host, /0 semua alamat, permit mengizinkan, dan deny menolak. Perhatikan urutan aturan: kecocokan pertama menentukan tindakan.

questions.stem: A data administrator is configuring authentication for a SaaS application and would like to reduce the number of credentials employees need to maintain. The company prefers to use domain credentials to access new SaaS applications. Which of the following methods would allow this functionality?
questions.explanation: Satu login domain dipakai lintas aplikasi melalui SSO. Federation membangun hubungan kepercayaan lintas sistem; MFA menambah faktor; PEAP dan LEAP adalah metode EAP yang terkait akses jaringan.

questions.stem: Which of the following scenarios describes a possible business email compromise attack?
options: An employee receives a gift card request in an email that has an executive’s name in the display field of the email.
Employees who open an email attachment receive messages demanding payment in order to access files.
A service desk employee receives an email from the HR director asking for log-in credentials to a cloud administrator account.
An employee receives an email with a link to a phishing site that is designed to look like the company’s email portal.
questions.explanation: Permintaan akses admin oleh pihak yang berpura-pura sebagai HR cocok dengan BEC. Permintaan gift card yang menyamar sebagai eksekutif juga bisa menjadi BEC; soal ini punya dua skenario yang masuk akal. Lampiran pengunci file lebih mengarah ke ransomware.

questions.stem: A company prevented direct access from the database administrators’ workstations to the network segment that contains database servers. Which of the following should a database administrator use to access the database servers?
questions.explanation: DBA masuk melalui perantara yang diawasi. Jump server menjadi jalur administratif; RADIUS mengurus AAA, HSM melindungi kunci, load balancer membagi trafik.

questions.stem: An organization’s internet-facing website was compromised when an attacker exploited a buffer overflow. Which of the following should the organization deploy to best protect against similar attacks in the future?
questions.explanation: Di antara opsi, WAF berada di jalur HTTP dan dapat memblokir pola permintaan berbahaya. Perbaikan buffer overflow tetap perlu patch atau perbaikan kode. TLS melindungi kanal; SD-WAN mengelola konektivitas.

questions.stem: An administrator notices that several users are logging in from suspicious IP addresses. After speaking with the users, the administrator determines that the employees were not logging in from those IP addresses and resets the affected users’ passwords. Which of the following should the administrator implement to prevent this type of attack from succeeding in the future?
questions.explanation: Reset password menghentikan kredensial lama. MFA menambah syarat masuk ketika password bocor; pengaturan permission membatasi tindakan setelah masuk. Evaluasi dan cabut sesi lama jika relevan.

questions.stem: An employee receives a text message that appears to have been sent by the payroll department and is asking for credential verification. Which of the following social engineering techniques are being attempted? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: SMS menentukan kanal smishing. Mengaku dari payroll adalah impersonation. Vishing memakai suara; typosquatting membutuhkan nama domain yang mirip.

questions.stem:
Several employees received a fraudulent text message from someone claiming to be the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). The message stated:
“I’m in an airport right now with no access to email. I need you to buy gift cards for employee recognition awards. Please send the gift cards to following email address.”
Which of the following are the best responses to this situation? (Choose two).
options: Cancel current employee recognition gift cards
Add a smishing exercise to the annual company training
Issue a general email warning to the company
Have the CEO change phone numbers
Conduct a forensic investigation on the CEO's phone
questions.explanation: Peringatan cepat melindungi rekan kerja saat kampanye berlangsung; latihan smishing membangun kebiasaan verifikasi jangka panjang. Penyamar tidak membuktikan ponsel CEO terkompromi.

questions.stem: A company is required to use certified hardware when building networks. Which of the following best addresses the risks associated with procuring counterfeit hardware?
options: A thorough analysis of the supply chain
A legally enforceable corporate acquisition policy
A right to audit clause in vendor contracts and SOWs
An in depth penetration test of all suppliers and vendors
questions.explanation: Telusuri asal, distributor, sertifikasi, dan rantai pengadaan untuk mengurangi risiko barang palsu. Klausul audit memberi hak memeriksa; kebijakan pengadaan mengarahkan proses.

questions.stem: Which of the following provides the details about the terms of a test with a third-party penetration tester?
questions.explanation: Rules of engagement menetapkan ruang lingkup, waktu, batas, kontak, dan kondisi berhenti. SOW menetapkan pekerjaan dan deliverable; hak audit menetapkan izin pemeriksaan.

questions.stem: A penetration tester begins an engagement by performing port and service scans against the client environment according to the rules of engagement. Which of the following reconnaissance types is the tester performing?
questions.explanation: Interaksi langsung dengan sistem membuat aktivitas ini active reconnaissance. Passive reconnaissance memanfaatkan informasi yang sudah tersedia. Konteksnya tes yang diotorisasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following is required for an organization to properly manage its restore process in the event of system failure?
questions.explanation: DRP mengatur pemulihan sistem, urutan dependensi, orang, dan prosedur restore. IRP mengatur penanganan insiden; RPO memberi target kehilangan data.

questions.stem: Which of the following vulnerabilities is associated with installing software outside of a manufacturer’s approved software repository?
questions.explanation: Sideloading adalah pemasangan dari luar kanal distribusi resmi. Jailbreaking mengubah batas platform; sideloading dapat tersedia tanpa jailbreak.

Banyak akun dicoba dalam rentang singkat, sehingga pola cocok dengan password spraying. Brute force per akun menumpuk percobaan pada sasaran sempit; pass-the-hash berkaitan dengan reuse material autentikasi.

questions.stem: An analyst is evaluating the implementation of Zero Trust principles within the data plane. Which of the following would be most relevant for the analyst to evaluate?
questions.explanation: Zona dan PEP berkaitan dengan jalur yang dilalui trafik. Control plane menilai identitas dan mengambil keputusan kebijakan; data plane menjalankan keputusan pada akses.

questions.stem: An engineer needs to find a solution that creates an added layer of security by preventing unauthorized access to internal company resources. Which of the following would be the best solution?
questions.explanation: Jump server memberikan titik masuk terkendali ke resource internal. RDP adalah protokol akses; proxy memediasi trafik; hypervisor menjalankan VM.

questions.stem: A company’s web filter is configured to scan the URL for strings and deny access when matches are found. Which of the following search strings should an analyst employ to prohibit access to non-encrypted websites?
questions.explanation: Skema HTTP mengindikasikan kanal web tanpa TLS. Port 443 biasanya HTTPS, tetapi port saja tidak menjamin enkripsi. Terapkan kebijakan berdasarkan skema dan validasi koneksi.

questions.stem: During a security incident, the security operations team identified sustained network traffic from a malicious IP address: 10.1.4.9. A security analyst is creating an inbound firewall rule to block the IP address from accessing the organization’s network. Which of the following fulfills this request?
options: access-list inbound deny ip source 0.0.0.0/0 destination 10.1.4.9/32
access-list inbound deny ip source 10.1.4.9/32 destination 0.0.0.0/0
access-list inbound permit ip source 10.1.4.9/32 destination 0.0.0.0/0
access-list inbound permit ip source 0.0.0.0/0 destination 10.1.4.9/32
questions.explanation: Aturan inbound memblokir alamat penyerang sebagai sumber dan mencakup tujuan yang relevan. Mengubah tujuan atau memakai permit membalik maksud kebijakan.

questions.stem: A company needs to provide administrative access to internal resources while minimizing the traffic allowed through the security boundary. Which of the following methods is most secure?
questions.explanation: Bastion membatasi jalur administrasi ke satu sistem yang diperkeras. Perimeter network memberi zona isolasi; WAF menangani trafik web; SSO menangani identitas.

questions.stem: A security analyst is reviewing alerts in the SIEM related to potential malicious network traffic coming from an employee’s corporate laptop. The security analyst has determined that additional data about the executable running on the machine is necessary to continue the investigation. Which of the following logs should the analyst use as a data source?
questions.explanation: Identitas executable, parent process, dan proses yang membuka koneksi tersedia dari endpoint. Firewall dan flow logs membantu menentukan alamat dan aliran trafik.

questions.stem:
A cyber operations team informs a security analyst about a new tactic malicious actors are using to compromise networks.
SIEM alerts have not yet been configured. Which of the following best describes what the security analyst should do to identify this behavior?
questions.explanation: Threat hunting mencari perilaku sebelum deteksi otomatis tersedia. Forensik berfokus pada bukti, e-discovery pada materi hukum, IR pada penanganan insiden.

questions.stem: A company purchased cyber insurance to address items listed on the risk register. Which of the following strategies does this represent?
questions.explanation: Asuransi memindahkan sebagian dampak finansial. Mitigate menurunkan risiko, avoid menghapus aktivitas, accept menerima risiko yang tersisa.

questions.stem: A security administrator would like to protect data on employees’ laptops. Which of the following encryption techniques should the security administrator use?
questions.explanation: FDE mencakup data di disk laptop saat perangkat terkunci atau mati. Enkripsi partisi lebih sempit; enkripsi database melindungi dataset tertentu.

questions.stem: Which of the following security control types does an acceptable use policy best represent?
questions.explanation: Di antara pilihan, kebijakan AUP dimaksudkan mencegah penyalahgunaan. Pada taksonomi fungsi, AUP juga contoh directive; pada taksonomi kategori, managerial.

questions.stem: An IT manager informs the entire help desk staff that only the IT manager and the help desk lead will have access to the administrator console of the help desk software. Which of the following security techniques is the IT manager setting up?
questions.explanation: Hanya peran yang perlu konsol admin mendapat akses. Hardening mengurangi permukaan serang; pemantauan mencatat penggunaan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most likely to be used to document risks, responsible parties, and thresholds?
questions.explanation: Risk register menyimpan risiko, owner, status, threshold dan tindakan. Analisis memberi masukan; toleransi memberi batas; transfer adalah respons.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a security administrator adhere to when setting up a new set of firewall rules?
questions.explanation: Firewall production memerlukan persetujuan, analisis dampak, uji, jadwal dan rollback. DRP dan BCP dipakai dalam konteks pemulihan dan kontinuitas.

questions.stem: A company is expanding its threat surface program and allowing individuals to security test the company’s internet-facing application. The company will compensate researchers based on the vulnerabilities discovered. Which of the following best describes the program the company is setting up?
questions.explanation: Imbalan untuk temuan yang valid dan sesuai scope adalah ciri bug bounty. Pentest biasanya engagement yang ditugaskan; red team menguji ketahanan lebih luas.

questions.stem: Which of the following threat actors is the most likely to use large financial resources to attack critical systems located in other countries?
questions.explanation: Bahasa sasaran strategis lintas negara dan sumber daya besar cocok dengan nation-state. Motif pelaku perlu bukti tambahan di dunia nyata.

questions.stem: Which of the following enables the use of an input field to run commands that can view or manipulate data?
questions.explanation: Input yang memengaruhi query database adalah SQL injection. XSS berjalan di browser; gunakan parameterized queries untuk memisahkan data dari query.

questions.stem: Employees in the research and development business unit receive extensive training to ensure they understand how to best protect company data. Which of the following is the type of data these employees are most likely to use in day-to-day work activities?
questions.explanation: R&D menghasilkan desain, metode dan pengetahuan yang merupakan intellectual property. Encrypted adalah status proteksi; in transit adalah keadaan data.

questions.stem: A company has begun labeling all laptops with asset inventory stickers and associating them with employee IDs. Which of the following security benefits do these actions provide? (Choose two.)
options: If a security incident occurs on the device, the correct employee can be notified.
The security team will be able to send user awareness training to the appropriate device.
Users can be mapped to their devices when configuring software MFA tokens.
User-based firewall policies can be correctly targeted to the appropriate laptops.
When conducting penetration testing, the security team will be able to target the desired laptops.
Company data can be accounted for when the employee leaves the organization.
questions.explanation: Pemetaan aset ke pemilik membantu kontak insiden dan pengembalian perangkat saat offboarding. Inventory menyediakan data kepemilikan; kebijakan jaringan tetap perlu konfigurasi tersendiri.

questions.stem: A technician wants to improve the situational and environmental awareness of existing users as they transition from remote to in-office work. Which of the following is the best option?
options: Update the content of new hire documentation
Modify the content of recurring training
questions.explanation: Perbarui pelatihan berkala untuk staf yang beralih ke kantor. Materi onboarding menjangkau pegawai baru; simulasi phishing hanya menguji sebagian kebutuhan.

questions.stem: A newly appointed board member with cybersecurity knowledge wants the board of directors to receive a quarterly report detailing the number of incidents that impacted the organization. The systems administrator is creating a way to present the data to the board of directors. Which of the following should the systems administrator use?
questions.explanation: Dashboard meringkas tren dan dampak untuk dewan. PCAP dan hasil scan cocok untuk analisis teknis sumber, bukan ringkasan eksekutif.

questions.stem:
A systems administrator receives the following alert from a file integrity monitoring tool:
The hash of the cmd.exe file has changed.
The systems administrator checks the OS logs and notices that no patches were applied in the last two months. Which of the following most likely occurred?
options: The end user changed the file permissions
A snapshot of the file system was taken
questions.explanation: Hash binary berubah tanpa patch sah memberi dugaan tampering; rootkit opsi yang paling sesuai. Perubahan izin biasa tidak mengubah isi file; FIM tidak membuktikan jenis malware.

questions.stem: Which of the following roles, according to the shared responsibility model, is responsible for securing the company’s database in an IaaS model for a cloud environment?
questions.explanation: Pada IaaS pelanggan mengamankan database dan konfigurasi workload. Provider bertanggung jawab pada infrastruktur yang mendasari; pembagian pada PaaS berbeda.

questions.stem: A client asked a security company to provide a document outlining the project, the cost, and the completion time frame. Which of the following documents should the company provide to the client?
questions.explanation: SOW merinci ruang lingkup, biaya, jadwal dan hasil kerja. MSA mengatur syarat umum, SLA mengatur metrik layanan, BPA mengatur hubungan bisnis.

questions.stem: A security team is reviewing the findings in a report that was delivered after a third party performed a penetration test. One of the findings indicated that a web application form field is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. Which of the following application security techniques should the security analyst recommend the developer implement to prevent this vulnerability?
questions.explanation: Validasi input adalah opsi terdekat. Untuk mencegah XSS, utamakan encoding output sesuai konteks dan sanitasi konten HTML bila diperlukan. Secure cookie membatasi dampak pada sesi.

questions.stem: Which of the following must be considered when designing a high-availability network? (Choose two).
questions.explanation: Responsiveness dan ease of recovery berkaitan langsung dengan kontinuitas. Desain HA perlu health check dan failover teruji; patchability tetap pertimbangan operasional.

questions.stem: A technician needs to apply a high-priority patch to a production system. Which of the following steps should be taken first?
options: Move the system to a different network segment
Apply the patch to the system
questions.explanation: Ajukan emergency change sesuai prosedur sebelum patch produksi. Urgensi dapat mempercepat jalur persetujuan, sambil mempertahankan rencana rollback.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the reason root cause analysis should be conducted as part of incident response?
options: To gather IoCs for the investigation
To discover which systems have been affected
To eradicate any trace of malware on the network
To prevent future incidents of the same nature
questions.explanation: RCA mencari penyebab dasar agar tindakan perbaikan mencegah kejadian serupa. IOCs mendukung deteksi, scope membatasi dampak, eradication menghapus penyebab aktif.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most likely outcome if a large bank fails an internal PCI DSS compliance assessment?
questions.explanation: Audit internal pertama-tama menghasilkan temuan dan rekomendasi. Sanksi atau reputasi bergantung pada tindak lanjut dan konteks eksternal.

questions.stem: A company is developing a business continuity strategy and needs to determine how many staff members would be required to sustain the business in the case of a disruption. Which of the following best describes this step?
questions.explanation: Menghitung personel minimum termasuk capacity planning. Redundancy menyediakan cadangan; dispersion memisahkan lokasi; tabletop menguji koordinasi. Jawaban analisis.

questions.stem: A company’s legal department drafted sensitive documents in a SaaS application and wants to ensure the documents cannot be accessed by individuals in high-risk countries. Which of the following is the most effective way to limit this access?
questions.explanation: Geolocation policy membatasi akses menurut lokasi. Sovereignty menjelaskan yurisdiksi data, masking mengurangi paparan isi, enkripsi melindungi keterbacaan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a hardware-specific vulnerability?
questions.explanation: Firmware berjalan khusus pada perangkat. XSS dan SQL injection terkait aplikasi; buffer overflow adalah kelas kelemahan memori yang dapat muncul di berbagai lapisan.

questions.stem:
While troubleshooting a firewall configuration, a technician determines that a “deny any” policy should be added to the bottom of the ACL. The technician updates the policy, but the new policy causes several company servers to become unreachable.
Which of the following actions would prevent this issue?
options: Documenting the new policy in a change request and submitting the request to change management
Testing the policy in a non-production environment before enabling the policy in the production network
Disabling any intrusion prevention signatures on the “deny any” policy prior to enabling the new policy
Including an “allow any” policy above the “deny any” policy
questions.explanation: Uji kebijakan baru di nonproduksi untuk menangkap akses yang akan terputus. Change request memberi jejak persetujuan; uji nyata memvalidasi dampak.

questions.stem: An organization is building a new backup data center with cost-benefit as the primary requirement and RTO and RPO values around two days. Which of the following types of sites is the best for this scenario?
questions.explanation: Warm site menyeimbangkan biaya dan kesiapan untuk target dua hari. Cold perlu lebih banyak penyiapan; hot lebih siap dengan biaya lebih tinggi. Lihat bab Disaster Recovery untuk pembahasan lengkap.

questions.stem: A company requires hard drives to be securely wiped before sending decommissioned systems to recycling. Which of the following best describes this policy?
questions.explanation: Sanitization membuat data lama tidak dapat diakses sesuai metode dan media. Destruction menghancurkan media; inventory hanya mencatat aset.

questions.stem: A systems administrator works for a local hospital and needs to ensure patient data is protected and secure. Which of the following data classifications should be used to secure patient data?
questions.explanation: Data pasien sensitif karena dampak privasi dan regulasi. Critical berhubungan dengan dampak operasional bila data hilang. Klasifikasi internal bisa berbeda.

questions.stem: A U.S.-based cloud-hosting provider wants to expand its data centers to new international locations. Which of the following should the hosting provider consider first?
options: Risks from hackers residing in other countries
Time zone differences in log correlation
questions.explanation: Mulai dari aturan perlindungan data di yurisdiksi baru. Kontrak dan log tetap penting setelah jelas aturan yang mengikat.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best way to block unknown programs from executing?
questions.explanation: Application allowlist hanya mengizinkan software yang disetujui berjalan. Firewall mengatur komunikasi; DLP mengatur perpindahan data.

questions.stem:
A company hired a consultant to perform an offensive security assessment covering penetration testing and social engineering.
Which of the following teams will conduct this assessment activity?
questions.explanation: Red team menjalankan simulasi lawan yang diotorisasi. Blue membela, purple mempertemukan pembelajaran keduanya, white mengawasi aturan.

questions.stem: A software development manager wants to ensure the authenticity of the code created by the company. Which of the following options is the most appropriate?
options: Testing input validation on the user input fields
Performing code signing on campany-developed software
Performing static code analysis on the software
questions.explanation: Code signing membuktikan integritas dan asal paket relatif terhadap signer yang dipercaya. Analisis statis mencari kelemahan; validasi input memperkuat aplikasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be used to identify potential attacker activities without affecting production servers?
questions.explanation: Honeypot menyediakan umpan terisolasi dan sinyal ketika disentuh. Zero Trust membatasi akses; CCTV dan geofencing mengamati aspek lain.

questions.stem: During an investigation, an incident response team attempts to understand the source of an incident. Which of the following incident response activities describes this process?
questions.explanation: Menentukan sumber adalah analysis. Detection menemukan sinyal; containment membatasi penyebaran; lessons learned mengevaluasi perbaikan.

questions.stem: A security practitioner completes a vulnerability assessment on a company’s network and finds several vulnerabilities, which the operations team remediates. Which of the following should be done next?
questions.explanation: Rescan memeriksa hasil remediation pada ruang lingkup yang sama. Audit atau laporan tidak langsung membuktikan temuan sudah hilang.

questions.stem:
An administrator was notified that a user logged in remotely after hours and copied large amounts of data to a personal device.
Which of the following best describes the user’s activity?
questions.explanation: Akses sah yang dipakai menyalin data ke perangkat pribadi mengarah ke insider threat. Selidiki kemungkinan akun dibajak sebelum mengatribusikan orang.

questions.stem: Which of the following allows for the attribution of messages to individuals?
questions.explanation: Non-repudiation mendukung atribusi pesan lewat bukti seperti signature. Authentication memverifikasi identitas pada saat login; log memberi konteks.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to consistently determine on a daily basis whether security settings on servers have been modified?
questions.explanation: Bandingkan konfigurasi harian terhadap baseline secara otomatis. Audit manual atau attestation memberi bukti pada interval berbeda.

questions.stem: Which of the following tools can assist with detecting an employee who has accidentally emailed a file containing a customer’s PII?
questions.explanation: DLP dapat mengidentifikasi PII di email atau lampiran. NetFlow menunjukkan metadata trafik; antivirus mencari malware; SCAP menilai konfigurasi.

questions.stem:
An organization recently updated its security policy to include the following statement:
Regular expressions are included in source code to remove special characters such as $, |, ;. &, `, and ? from variables set by forms in a web application.
Which of the following best explains the security technique the organization adopted by making this addition to the policy?
questions.explanation: Pemeriksaan dan penyaringan input adalah konsep yang dimaksud. Desain produksi memvalidasi tipe dan bentuk yang diizinkan serta memisahkan data dari perintah.

questions.stem: A security analyst and the management team are reviewing the organizational performance of a recent phishing campaign. The user click-through rate exceeded the acceptable risk threshold, and the management team wants to reduce the impact when a user clicks on a link in a phishing message. Which of the following should the analyst do?
options: Place posters around the office to raise awareness of common phishing activities.
Implement email security filters to prevent phishing emails from being delivered.
Update the EDR policies to block automatic execution of downloaded programs.
Create additional training for users to recognize the signs of phishing attempts.
questions.explanation: Soal menanyakan dampak setelah klik; aturan endpoint dapat menghambat eksekusi lanjutan. Filter email dan pelatihan menurunkan peluang klik.

questions.stem: Which of the following has been implemented when a host-based firewall on a legacy Linux system allows connections from only specific internal IP addresses?
questions.explanation: Pembatasan akses menjadi kompensasi ketika kontrol standar sulit diterapkan pada sistem lama. Firewall adalah mekanisme teknis; segmentation adalah desain pemisahan.

questions.stem:
The management team notices that new accounts that are set up manually do not always have correct access or permissions.
Which of the following automation techniques should a systems administrator use to streamline account creation?
questions.explanation: Provisioning terstandar membuat akun dan menerapkan hak dari sumber identitas. Workflow tiket mengatur persetujuan; guardrail membatasi tindakan yang tidak sesuai.

questions.stem: A company is planning to set up a SIEM system and assign an analyst to review the logs on a weekly basis. Which of the following types of controls is the company setting up?
questions.explanation: Meninjau log untuk mengenali kejadian adalah detective. Preventive membatasi kejadian sebelumnya; corrective mengembalikan kondisi.

questions.stem: A systems administrator is looking for a low-cost application-hosting solution that is cloud-based. Which of the following meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Serverless mengurangi pengelolaan host dan bisa efisien untuk beban sporadis. Biaya nyata bergantung pada eksekusi, data, dan trafik.

questions.stem: A security operations center determines that the malicious activity detected on a server is normal. Which of the following activities describes the act of ignoring detected activity in the future?
questions.explanation: Tuning menyesuaikan kondisi, ambang, atau pengecualian setelah false positive terkonfirmasi. Aggregation menggabungkan data; quarantine mengisolasi aset.

options: The user jsmit's account has been locked out
A keylogger is installed on jsmith's workstation
An attacker is attempting to brute force jsmith's account
Ransomware has been deployed in the domain
questions.explanation: Log memperlihatkan password berhasil dan MFA gagal berulang untuk satu akun. Kunci menyebut brute force; bukti yang terlihat lebih spesifik pada percobaan faktor kedua. Cek sumber login dan status akun sebelum menyimpulkan lockout.

questions.stem: A company is concerned about weather events causing damage to the server room and downtime. Which of the following should the company consider?
questions.explanation: Pemisahan geografis mengurangi kegagalan yang mengenai semua lokasi. Cluster lokal berbagi risiko fisik; backup offsite menjaga data dan masih perlu restore.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a primary security concern for a company setting up a BYOD program?
questions.explanation: Jailbreak dapat melemahkan proteksi platform BYOD. MDM dan kebijakan posture menentukan perangkat mana yang boleh mengakses data kerja.

questions.stem:
A company decided to reduce the cost of its annual cyber insurance policy by removing the coverage for ransomware attacks.
Which of the following analysis elements did the company most likely use in making this decision?
questions.explanation: ARO mengestimasi frekuensi tahunan. Untuk keputusan asuransi, kombinasikan dengan dampak per insiden dan syarat penanggungan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most likely to be included as an element of communication in a security awareness program?
options: Reporting phishing attempts or other suspicious activities
Detecting insider threats using anomalous behavior recognition
Verifying information when modifying wire transfer data
Performing social engineering as part of third-party penetration testing
questions.explanation: Ajari pegawai bagaimana melaporkan pesan mencurigakan dan siapa yang dihubungi. Analitik insider dan uji pentest merupakan pekerjaan tim khusus.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the phase in the incident response process when a security analyst reviews roles and responsibilities?
questions.explanation: Pembagian peran ditetapkan pada preparation. Recovery mengembalikan layanan dan lessons learned memperbaiki proses setelah kejadian.

questions.stem: After a recent vulnerability scan, a security engineer needs to harden the routers within the corporate network. Which of the following is the most appropriate to disable?
questions.explanation: Nonaktifkan administrasi web yang tidak diperlukan agar permukaan serang berkurang. Routing protocol dan VLAN berfungsi untuk jaringan; pertahankan jalur admin aman.

questions.stem: A security administrator needs a method to secure data in an environment that includes some form of checks so track any changes. Which of the following should the administrator set up to achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: FIM membandingkan integritas file terhadap baseline. GPO menerapkan kebijakan; SPF membantu verifikasi pengirim email; NAC mengontrol akses jaringan.
Percobaan autentikasi berulang mendukung brute force. Bedakan rangkaian gagal dengan satu lupa password, dan cek apakah akhirnya ada login sukses.

questions.stem: A security engineer is implementing FDE for all laptops in an organization. Which of the following are the most important for the engineer to consider as part of the planning process? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: TPM dapat mengikat pelepasan kunci ke kondisi perangkat. Escrow menyediakan jalur pemulihan; lindungi recovery key dan batasi aksesnya.

questions.stem: A security analyst scans a company's public network and discovers a host is running a remote desktop that can be used to access the production network. Which of the following changes should the security analyst recommend?
options: Changing the remote desktop port to a non-standard number
Setting up a VPN and placing the jump server inside the firewall
Using a proxy for web connections from the remote desktop server
Connecting the remote server to the domain and increasing the password length
questions.explanation: VPN dan jump server internal mengurangi paparan akses admin. Mengubah port saja tidak menghilangkan keterjangkauan layanan.

questions.stem: An enterprise has been experiencing attacks focused on exploiting vulnerabilities in older browser versions with well-known exploits. Which of the following security solutions should be configured to best provide the ability to monitor and block these known signature-based attacks?
questions.explanation: IPS inspeksi inline dapat memblokir pola yang terdeteksi. IDS memberi alert; ACL menilai aturan jaringan; patch browser memperbaiki sumber kelemahan.

questions.stem: Security controls in a data center are being reviewed to ensure data is properly protected and that human life considerations are included. Which of the following best describes how the controls should be set up?
options: Remote access points should fail closed
Logical security controls should fail open
questions.explanation: Keselamatan manusia menuntut akses keluar tetap tersedia saat perangkat gagal. Fail closed menjaga pembatasan masuk; keputusan pintu tertentu mengikuti aturan keselamatan.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be best suited for constantly changing environments?
questions.explanation: Container mudah diganti dan di-deploy ulang lewat image. RTOS dan SCADA disusun untuk kebutuhan waktu nyata atau kontrol industri.

questions.stem: Which of the following incident response activities ensures evidence is properly handled?
questions.explanation: Chain of custody mencatat siapa menangani bukti, kapan dan bagaimana. Preservation menjaga isi; legal hold menunda penghapusan rutin.

questions.stem: An accounting clerk sent money to an attacker's bank account after receiving fraudulent instructions to use a new account. Which of the following would most likely prevent this activity in the future?
options: Updating processes for sending wire transfers
questions.explanation: Verifikasi perubahan rekening lewat kanal independen dan persetujuan kedua. Pelatihan membantu mengenali penipuan; kontrol transaksi langsung mengurangi dampak.

questions.stem: A systems administrator is creating a script that would save time and prevent human error when performing account creation for a large number of end users. Which of the following would be a good use case for this task?
questions.explanation: Kunci memakai orchestration untuk workflow pembuatan akun massal. Skrip satu tugas sendiri lebih tepat disebut automation; orchestration mengoordinasi banyak langkah.

questions.stem: A company's marketing department collects, modifies, and stores sensitive customer data. The infrastructure team is responsible for securing the data while in transit and at rest. Which of the following data roles describes the customer?
questions.explanation: Pelanggan adalah data subject. Owner menetapkan tanggung jawab internal; custodian menjalankan pengamanan; processor menangani data atas instruksi controller.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the maximum allowance of accepted risk?
questions.explanation: Threshold adalah batas keputusan yang bisa diukur atau memicu eskalasi. Appetite menyatakan risiko yang organisasi bersedia ambil, tolerance menunjukkan variasi yang masih dapat diterima.

questions.stem: A security analyst receives alerts about an internal system sending a large amount of unusual DNS queries to systems on the internet over short periods of time during non-business hours. Which of the following is most likely occurring?
options: A worm is propagating across the network
A logic bomb is deleting data
questions.explanation: Volume dan pola DNS yang menyimpang dapat mengindikasikan pemindahan data. Cocokkan asal trafik, proses dan domain sebelum menyimpulkan; kueri banyak juga bisa sah.

questions.stem: A technician is opening ports on a firewall for a new system being deployed and supported by a SaaS provider. Which of the following is a risk in the new system?
questions.explanation: Penyedia yang memasok serta menopang sistem menambah risiko rantai pasok. Evaluasi akses, kontrak, notifikasi insiden dan dependensi vendor.

questions.stem:
A systems administrator is working on a solution with the following requirements:
• Provide a secure zone.
• Enforce a company-wide access control policy.
• Reduce the scope of threats.
Which of the following is the systems administrator setting up?
questions.explanation: Zonasi, policy yang konsisten, dan pembatasan cakupan dampak mendukung Zero Trust. AAA adalah fungsi identitas dan pencatatan; CIA adalah tujuan keamanan.

questions.stem: Which of the following involves an attempt to take advantage of database misconfigurations?
questions.explanation: SQL injection terkait input yang mengubah makna kueri database. Misconfiguration bisa memperbesar dampaknya; akar masalah biasanya pemisahan data dan query yang gagal.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to validate a certificate when it is presented to a user?
questions.explanation: OCSP meminta status pencabutan sertifikat tertentu. CRL menyediakan daftar yang dapat diambil berkala. Pemeriksaan rantai, nama, masa berlaku, dan status masing-masing menjawab pertanyaan berbeda.

questions.stem: One of a company's vendors sent an analyst a security bulletin that recommends a BIOS update. Which of the following vulnerability types is being addressed by the patch?
questions.explanation: BIOS/UEFI adalah firmware platform. Update dapat menutup kelemahan sebelum OS berjalan; lakukan validasi vendor dan change control.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to quantitatively measure the criticality of a vulnerability?
questions.explanation: CVSS memberi ukuran severity teknis. CVE adalah identitas kelemahan. Prioritas operasi juga melihat exposure, eksploitasi yang diketahui, dan aset terdampak.

questions.stem: Which of the following actions could a security engineer take to ensure workstations and servers are properly monitored for unauthorized changes and software?
options: Configure all systems to log scheduled tasks
Collect and monitor all traffic exiting the network
Block traffic based on known malicious signatures
Install endpoint management software on all systems
questions.explanation: Endpoint management memberi inventaris dan cara menerapkan patch atau baseline seragam. Cek keberhasilan deployment dan perangkat yang belum melapor.

questions.stem: An organization is leveraging a VPN between its headquarters and a branch location. Which of the following is the VPN protecting?
questions.explanation: VPN mengamankan data ketika bergerak antar lokasi. At rest adalah data tersimpan; in use adalah data sedang diproses.

Bank memilih false positive karena pengujian menunjukkan server Telnet mendukung enkripsi. Dalam praktik, dukungan enkripsi belum membuktikan bahwa sesi plaintext ditolak. Validasi kebijakan server dan sesi aktual sebelum menutup temuan.

questions.stem: An organization disabled unneeded services and placed a firewall in front of a business-critical legacy system. Which of the following best describes the actions taken by the organization?
questions.explanation: Firewall dan pengurangan layanan menekan risiko saat legacy system belum bisa memakai kontrol normal. Pengganti sementara perlu owner dan evaluasi berkala.

questions.stem: A security consultant needs secure, remote access to a client environment. Which of the following should the security consultant most likely use to gain access?
questions.explanation: IPsec memungkinkan komunikasi IP terenkripsi melalui jaringan tak tepercaya. TLS biasanya melindungi sesi aplikasi; akses admin tetap perlu identitas dan pembatasan.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a systems administrator use to ensure an easy deployment of resources within the cloud provider?
questions.explanation: IaC mendefinisikan resource sebagai konfigurasi yang bisa diulang dan direview. Scripting tugas tunggal bisa mengotomasi langkah; deklarasi resource membantu konsistensi lingkungan.

questions.stem: After a security awareness training session, a user called the IT help desk and reported a suspicious call. The suspicious caller stated that the Chief Financial Officer wanted credit card information in order to close an invoice. Which of the following topics did the user recognize from the training?
questions.explanation: Panggilan mencurigakan memanfaatkan kepercayaan manusia. Jika kanal suara jelas dan spesifik, istilahnya vishing. Verifikasi lewat nomor resmi.

questions.stem: A security administrator is deploying a DLP solution to prevent the exfiltration of sensitive customer data. Which of the following should the administrator do first?
options: Block access to cloud storage websites
Create a rule to block outgoing email attachments
Remove all user permissions from shares on the file server
questions.explanation: Klasifikasi menentukan jenis data yang harus dikenali DLP dan tindakan yang sesuai. Aturan blokir diterapkan setelah kategori dan alur bisnis diketahui.

questions.stem: An administrator assists the legal and compliance team with ensuring information about customer transactions is archived for the proper time period. Which of the following data policies is the administrator carrying out?
questions.explanation: Retention menentukan berapa lama transaksi disimpan. Disposal menentukan cara menghapus setelah masa simpan, kecuali ada legal hold.

questions.stem: A company is working with a vendor to perform a penetration test. Which of the following includes an estimate about the number of hours required to complete the engagement?
questions.explanation: SOW merinci pekerjaan, waktu, biaya, dan keluaran. ROE menetapkan batas teknis dan operasional pengujian; SLA menetapkan kualitas layanan.

questions.stem: A Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) wants to explicitly raise awareness about the increase of ransomware-as-a-service in a report to the management team. Which of the following best describes the threat actor in the CISO’s report?
questions.explanation: Keuntungan dari ransomware cocok dengan motif organized crime. Insider, hacktivist dan nation-state memiliki konteks serta motif yang dapat berbeda.

questions.stem: Which of the following practices would be best to prevent an insider from introducing malicious code into a company's development process?
questions.explanation: Review dan persetujuan independen mengurangi peluang satu orang memasukkan perubahan berbahaya. Branch protection dapat menegakkan proses ini.

questions.stem: Which of the following can best protect against an employee inadvertently installing malware on a company system?
questions.explanation: Allowlist membatasi eksekusi program ke katalog yang disetujui. Antivirus mendeteksi pola atau perilaku; hak pengguna minimal mengurangi ruang dampak.

questions.stem: A company is adding a clause to its AUP that states employees are not allowed to modify the operating system on mobile devices. Which of the following vulnerabilities is the organization addressing?
questions.explanation: Jailbreaking mengubah pembatasan OS. Sideloading memasang aplikasi di luar distribusi resmi dan tidak selalu mengubah sistem operasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best ways to ensure only authorized personnel can access a secure facility? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Badge memeriksa hak masuk. Vestibule mengatur lalu lintas orang dan membantu mengurangi tailgating. CCTV terutama memberi rekaman.

questions.stem: An organization would like to store customer data on a separate part of the network that is not accessible to users on the main corporate network. Which of the following should the administrator use to accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation: Segmentasi memisahkan pelanggan atau aset sensitif dan membatasi trafik antarzona. VLAN perlu disertai enforcement jika ingin membatasi akses.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most common data loss path for an air-gapped network?
questions.explanation: Media lepas dapat menyeberangi batas fisik jaringan air-gapped. Kontrol media dan transfer resmi diperlukan meskipun tidak ada koneksi jaringan langsung.

questions.stem: Malware spread across a company's network after an employee visited a compromised industry blog. Which of the following best describes this type of attack?
questions.explanation: Situs yang rutin dikunjungi target dikompromikan agar menjangkau komunitas tertentu. Spear phishing memakai pesan yang ditargetkan; watering hole memakai tempat yang dikunjungi.

questions.stem: An organization is struggling with scaling issues on its VPN concentrator and internet circuit due to remote work. The organization is looking for a software solution that will allow it to reduce traffic on the VPN and internet circuit, while still providing encrypted tunnel access to the data center and monitoring of remote employee internet traffic. Which of the following will help achieve these objectives?
options: Deploying a SASE solution to remote employees
Building a load-balanced VPN solution with redundant internet
Purchasing a low-cost SD-WAN solution for VPN traffic
Using a cloud provider to create additional VPN concentrator
questions.explanation: SASE mendistribusikan akses dan inspeksi melalui layanan cloud. VPN terpusat dapat tetap berguna untuk sebagian workload, tapi punya batas kapasitas konsentrator.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best reason to complete an audit in a banking environment?
questions.explanation: Konteks perbankan menonjolkan kewajiban regulasi untuk audit. Audit internal memperbaiki pengawasan; audit eksternal memberi independensi.

questions.stem: Which of the following security concepts is the best reason for permissions on a human resources fileshare to follow the principle of least privilege?
questions.explanation: Permission pada HR share membatasi siapa yang membaca data, sehingga menjaga confidentiality. Integrity membatasi perubahan atau mendeteksi tampering.

questions.stem: Which of the following are cases in which an engineer should recommend the decommissioning of a network device? (Choose two.)
options: The device has been moved from a production environment to a test environment.
The device is configured to use cleartext passwords.
The device is moved to an isolated segment on the enterprise network.
The device is moved to a different location in the enterprise.
The device's encryption level cannot meet organizational standards.
The device is unable to receive authorized updates.
questions.explanation: Kegagalan memenuhi standar enkripsi dan hilangnya kanal update sah membuat aset sulit dipertahankan. Tinjau migrasi, data disposal, dan penghapusan akses saat pensiun.

questions.stem: A company is required to perform a risk assessment on an annual basis. Which of the following types of risk assessments does this requirement describe?
questions.explanation: Penilaian tahunan adalah recurring assessment. Ad hoc merespons kejadian tertentu; continuous memakai data yang diperbarui lebih sering.

questions.stem: After a recent ransomware attack on a company's system, an administrator reviewed the log files. Which of the following control types did the administrator use?
questions.explanation: Review log mengungkap aktivitas yang telah terjadi. Itu fungsi detective; tindakan pemulihan setelahnya corrective.

questions.stem: Which of the following exercises should an organization use to improve its incident response process?
questions.explanation: Tabletop menguji peran dan keputusan melalui diskusi. Simulasi failover menguji jalur teknis dan target waktu sesungguhnya.

questions.stem: Which of the following best ensures minimal downtime and data loss for organizations with critical computing equipment located in earthquake-prone areas?
questions.explanation: Replikasi offsite menempatkan data di luar wilayah gangguan dan menekan gap data jika cukup sering. UPS/generator hanya menangani listrik di lokasi.

questions.stem: A newly identified network access vulnerability has been found in the OS of legacy IoT devices. Which of the following would best mitigate this vulnerability quickly?
questions.explanation: Segmen IoT terpisah mengurangi keterjangkauan perangkat yang belum bisa dipatch. Batasi jalur antarsegmen ke layanan yang dibutuhkan.

questions.stem: After an audit, an administrator discovers all users have access to confidential data on a file server. Which of the following should the administrator use to restrict access to the data quickly?
questions.explanation: ACL file mengatur akses ke resource per pengguna atau grup. RBAC menetapkan izin menurut peran dan dapat diwujudkan melalui grup serta ACL.

questions.stem: A client demands at least 99.99% uptime from a service provider's hosted security services. Which of the following documents includes the information the service provider should return to the client?
questions.explanation: SLA mendefinisikan target uptime, cara menghitung, pengecualian, dan penanganan pelanggaran. SOW mengatur pekerjaan proyek.

questions.stem: A company is discarding a classified storage array and hires an outside vendor to complete the disposal. Which of the following should the company request from the vendor?
questions.explanation: Sertifikat disposal menjadi bukti vendor telah melakukan pemusnahan atau sanitasi sesuai layanan. Cocokkan bukti dengan serial dan chain of custody.

questions.stem: A company is planning a disaster recovery site and needs to ensure that a single natural disaster would not result in the complete loss of regulated backup data. Which of the following should the company consider?
questions.explanation: Backup di lokasi dengan risiko bencana independen melindungi dari satu kejadian regional. Load balancer tidak dengan sendirinya memisahkan geografi.

questions.stem: A security analyst locates a potentially malicious video file on a server and needs to identify both the creation date and the file's creator. Which of the following actions would most likely give the security analyst the information required?
options: Use hexdump on the file's contents
questions.explanation: Metadata memberi petunjuk tanggal, format dan asal file. Nilai bisa berubah atau dipalsukan; cocokkan dengan sumber lain dan pertahankan salinan bukti.

questions.stem: Which of the following teams combines both offensive and defensive testing techniques to protect an organization's critical systems?
questions.explanation: Purple menyatukan temuan simulasi red dan upaya deteksi blue. White mengawasi engagement dan rules of engagement.

questions.stem: A small business uses kiosks on the sales floor to display product information for customers. A security team discovers the kiosks use end-of-life operating systems. Which of the following is the security team most likely to document as a security implication of the current architecture?
questions.explanation: Patch availability menentukan apakah kelemahan kiosk bisa diperbaiki. Jika belum tersedia, batasi fungsi dan koneksi serta catat risiko residual.

questions.stem: Which of the following would help ensure a security analyst is able to accurately measure the overall risk to an organization when a new vulnerability is disclosed?
options: A full inventory of all hardware and software
A list of system owners and their departments
questions.explanation: Inventaris perangkat lunak dan hardware menentukan cakupan assessment. Tanpa inventaris, aset yang tidak terpantau tidak masuk pengukuran risiko.

questions.stem: Which of the following best practices gives administrators a set period to perform changes to an operational system to ensure availability and minimize business impacts?
questions.explanation: Scheduled downtime ialah waktu yang disepakati untuk intervensi operasional. Maintenance window bisa ada tanpa downtime jika perubahan mendukung.

questions.stem: A company must ensure sensitive data at rest is rendered unreadable. Which of the following will the company most likely use?
questions.explanation: Enkripsi membuat data tersimpan tidak terbaca tanpa kunci. Masking menjaga tampilan tertentu; hash berguna untuk verifikasi satu arah.

questions.stem: A legacy device is being decommissioned and is no longer receiving updates or patches. Which of the following describes this scenario?
questions.explanation: End of support berarti vendor berhenti menyediakan perbaikan atau bantuan terkait. End of life menandai akhir lifecycle produk menurut vendor dan tanggalnya bisa berbeda.

questions.stem: A bank insists all of its vendors must prevent data loss on stolen laptops. Which of the following strategies is the bank requiring?
questions.explanation: Enkripsi at rest seperti FDE menekan risiko data laptop dibaca setelah dicuri. Enkripsi in transit melindungi komunikasi, bukan disk.

questions.stem: A company's end users are reporting that they are unable to reach external websites. After reviewing the performance data for the DNS severs, the analyst discovers that the CPU, disk, and memory usage are minimal, but the network interface is flooded with inbound traffic. Network logs show only a small number of DNS queries sent to this server. Which of the following best describes what the security analyst is seeing?
questions.explanation: Kunci menunjuk reflected DoS jika balasan dari pihak ketiga membanjiri korban. Bedakan reflection yang memakai perantara dan amplification yang memperbesar rasio trafik.

questions.stem: A systems administrator wants to prevent users from being able to access data based on their responsibilities. The administrator also wants to apply the required access structure via a simplified format. Which of the following should the administrator apply to the site recovery resource group?
questions.explanation: RBAC memberi hak menurut tugas atau job role. ABAC menilai atribut seperti lokasi atau posture; DAC mendelegasikan hak ke pemilik resource.

questions.stem: During the onboarding process, an employee needs to create a password for an intranet account. The password must include ten characters, numbers, and letters, and two special characters. Once the password is created, the company will grant the employee access to other company-owned websites based on the intranet profile. Which of the following access management concepts is the company most likely using to safeguard intranet accounts and grant access to multiple sites based on a user's intranet account? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Kompleksitas menyangkut kombinasi karakter pada password. Federation berkaitan dengan trust lintas sistem. Keduanya menjawab bagian berbeda dari soal; kompleksitas saja tidak membuktikan federation.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes a security alerting and monitoring tool that collects system, application, and network logs from multiple sources in a centralized system?
questions.explanation: SIEM mengumpulkan, menormalisasi, mengorelasikan dan memberi alert dari banyak log. SOAR mengoordinasi playbook respons.

questions.stem:
A network manager wants to protect the company's VPN by implementing multifactor authentication that uses:

Something you know -

Something you have -

Something you are -
Which of the following would accomplish the manager's goal?
options: VPN IP address, company ID, facial structure
Company URL, TLS certificate, home address
questions.explanation: Password = knowledge, token = possession, sidik jari = inherence. Dua password tetap satu jenis faktor.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best way to handle a critical business application that is running on a legacy server?
questions.explanation: Segmentasi membatasi akses aplikasi lama sambil layanan tetap berjalan. Rencanakan penggantian dan validasi kontrol kompensasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following vulnerabilities is exploited when an attacker overwrites a register with a malicious address?
questions.explanation: Buffer overflow menulis di luar kapasitas buffer dan dapat merusak data kontrol program. Perbaiki bounds check dan gunakan proteksi memori yang sesuai.

questions.stem: After a company was compromised, customers initiated a lawsuit. The company's attorneys have requested that the security team initiate a legal hold in response to the lawsuit. Which of the following describes the action the security team will most likely be required to take?
options: Retain the emails between the security team and affected customers for 30 days.
Retain any communications related to the security breach until further notice.
Retain any communications between security members during the breach response.
Retain all emails from the company to affected customers for an indefinite period of time.
questions.explanation: Instruksi pengacara untuk menahan penghapusan adalah legal hold. Retention rutin tetap berlaku pada materi di luar scope hold.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the process of concealing code or text inside a graphical image?
questions.explanation: Steganografi menyembunyikan keberadaan pesan dalam media pembawa. Enkripsi menyamarkan isi; hashing membuat digest.

questions.stem: An employee receives a text message from an unknown number claiming to be the company’s Chief Executive Officer and asking the employee to purchase several gift cards. Which of the following types of attacks does this describe?
questions.explanation: SMS dengan identitas CEO palsu adalah smishing; taktiknya impersonation. Vishing memakai suara dan phishing email memakai pesan elektronik.

questions.stem: Which of the following risk management strategies should an enterprise adopt first if a legacy application is critical to business operations and there are preventative controls that are not yet implemented?
questions.explanation: Mitigate menurunkan kemungkinan atau dampak sambil aplikasi dipertahankan. Avoid berarti menghentikan aktivitas; transfer mengalihkan sebagian konsekuensi.

questions.stem: Visitors to a secured facility are required to check in with a photo ID and enter the facility through an access control vestibule. Which of the following best describes this form of security control?
questions.explanation: Pemeriksaan ID dan vestibule membatasi masuk secara fisik. Kebijakan pengunjung adalah managerial atau operational, tergantung bagian yang dibahas.

questions.stem: The local administrator account for a company's VPN appliance was unexpectedly used to log in to the remote management interface. Which of the following would have most likely prevented this from happening?
questions.explanation: Ganti password bawaan dan kelola akun lokal admin. Setelah login mencurigakan, periksa log, sesi dan dampak sebelum menutup insiden.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to secure an on-site data center against intrusion from an insider?
questions.explanation: Badge mendukung pembatasan akses dan rekam masuk bagi staf. CCTV terutama deteksi; badge tidak mencegah semua tailgating.

questions.stem: An engineer moved to another team and is unable to access the new team's shared folders while still being able to access the shared folders from the former team. After opening a ticket, the engineer discovers that the account was never moved to the new group. Which of the following access controls is most likely causing the lack of access?
questions.explanation: Hak folder mengikuti role baru. Proses mover menghapus izin lama sekaligus menambah hak yang diperlukan untuk tim baru.

questions.stem: Which of the following factors are the most important to address when formulating a training curriculum plan for a security awareness program? (Choose two.)
options: Channels by which the organization communicates with customers
The reporting mechanisms for ethics violations
Threat vectors based on the industry in which the organization operates
Secure software development training for all personnel
Cadence and duration of training events
Retraining requirements for individuals who fail phishing simulations
questions.explanation: Ancaman sektor menentukan isi materi; cadence dan durasi menentukan seberapa sering kebiasaan dipraktikkan. Ukur pelaporan dan perbaikan setelah simulasi.

questions.stem: A network administrator is working on a project to deploy a load balancer in the company's cloud environment. Which of the following fundamental security requirements does this project fulfil?
questions.explanation: Load balancer membantu menjaga ketersediaan dengan mengarahkan trafik ke backend sehat. Kapasitas dan redundansi tiap lapisan tetap diperiksa.

questions.stem: A systems administrator is changing the password policy within an enterprise environment and wants this update implemented on all systems as quickly as possible. Which of the following operating system security measures will the administrator most likely use?
questions.explanation: GPO menerapkan pengaturan Windows secara terpusat. Validasi cakupan OU, hasil penerapan dan efek samping pada pengguna.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be most useful in determining whether the long-term cost to transfer a risk is less than the impact of the risk?
questions.explanation: ALE memperkirakan kerugian tahunan; bandingkan dengan biaya transfer dan klausul cakupan. SLE adalah dampak satu kejadian, ARO frekuensi tahunan.

questions.stem: In order to strengthen a password and prevent a hacker from cracking it, a random string of 36 characters was added to the password. Which of the following best describes this technique?a
questions.explanation: Salt unik mengurangi manfaat tabel hash prahitung dan mencegah pencocokan hash antar pengguna. KDF password juga menambah biaya tebakan.

questions.stem: A technician is deploying a new security camera. Which of the following should the technician do?
questions.explanation: Site survey memeriksa garis pandang, cahaya, blind spot dan jangkauan. Pengaturan VLAN atau akses kamera melindungi konektivitas setelah penempatan.

questions.stem: A company is experiencing a web services outage on the public network. The services are up and available but inaccessible. The network logs show a sudden increase in network traffic that is causing the outage. Which of the following attacks is the organization experiencing?
questions.explanation: Public endpoint tidak terjangkau sementara backend hidup mendukung dugaan DDoS di jalur akses. Periksa volume dan kesehatan komponen jaringan.

questions.stem: Which of the following threat actors is the most likely to be motivated by profit?
questions.explanation: Organized crime biasanya mencari keuntungan. Hacktivist punya motif ideologis; nation-state mengejar tujuan strategis.

questions.stem: An organization experiences a cybersecurity incident involving a command-and-control server. Which of the following logs should be analyzed to identify the impacted host? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Flow atau log network memberi pola koneksi; firewall memberi keputusan allow/deny dan tujuan. Endpoint melengkapi data proses yang memulai koneksi.

questions.stem: During a penetration test, a vendor attempts to enter an unauthorized area using an access badge. Which of the following types of tests does this represent?
questions.explanation: Badge untuk masuk area memeriksa kontrol fisik. Hasil harus ditafsirkan dalam ruang lingkup evaluasi yang diotorisasi.

questions.stem: A systems administrator uses a key to encrypt a message being sent to a peer in a different branch office. The peer then uses the same key to decrypt the message. Which of the following describes this example?
questions.explanation: Symmetric memakai secret key bersama. Asymmetric memakai pasangan kunci dan sering membantu membangun sesi atau memverifikasi signature.

questions.stem: A visitor plugs a laptop into a network jack in the lobby and is able to connect to the company's network. Which of the following should be configured on the existing network infrastructure to best prevent this activity?
questions.explanation: Port security membatasi perangkat yang bisa memakai switch port; 802.1X/NAC dapat memverifikasi identitas perangkat. Matikan port yang tidak digunakan.

questions.stem: A security administrator is reissuing a former employee's laptop. Which of the following is the best combination of data handling activities for the administrator to perform? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Sanitization menghapus data lama; sertifikasi mendokumentasikan tindakan. Inventory dan provisioning merekam siapa menerima perangkat selanjutnya.

questions.stem: A systems administrator would like to deploy a change to a production system. Which of the following must the administrator submit to demonstrate that the system can be restored to a working state in the event of a performance issue?
questions.explanation: Backout plan memulihkan keadaan sebelumnya jika perubahan gagal. Tetapkan kondisi rollback sebelum deployment dan verifikasi sesudahnya.

questions.stem: A company is redesigning its infrastructure and wants to reduce the number of physical servers in use. Which of the following architectures is best suited for this goal?
questions.explanation: Virtualization menjalankan beberapa guest pada host yang sama. Container berbagi kernel host; keduanya meningkatkan utilisasi dengan model isolasi berbeda.

questions.stem: A bank set up a new server that contains customers' PII. Which of the following should the bank use to make sure the sensitive data is not modified?
questions.explanation: FIM mengawasi perubahan file atau konfigurasi yang menyimpan PII. DLP melindungi aliran data; encryption melindungi keterbacaan.

questions.stem: Users at a company are reporting they are unable to access the URL for a new retail website because it is flagged as gambling and is being blocked. Which of the following changes would allow users to access the site?
options: Creating a firewall rule to allow HTTPS traffic
Configuring the IPS to allow shopping
Tuning the DLP rule that detects credit card data
Updating the categorization in the content filter
questions.explanation: Koreksi kategori URL jika telah divalidasi salah blokir. Pengecualian sempit lebih terukur daripada menonaktifkan filter.

questions.stem: Which of the following most impacts an administrator's ability to address CVEs discovered on a server?
questions.explanation: Patch availability menentukan apakah perbaikan vendor dapat diterapkan. Jika patch belum ada, kurangi paparan dan uji mitigasi alternatif.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes effective change management procedures?
options: Approving the change after a successful deployment
Having a backout plan when a patch fails
Using a spreadsheet for tracking changes
Using an automatic change control bypass for security updates
questions.explanation: Backout plan memberi jalan pemulihan sewaktu patch gagal. Persetujuan, uji dan jadwal adalah tahapan change yang saling melengkapi.

questions.stem: The CIRT is reviewing an incident that involved a human resources recruiter exfiltrating sensitive company data. The CIRT found that the recruiter was able to use HTTP over port 53 to upload documents to a web server. Which of the following security infrastructure devices could have identified and blocked this activity?
questions.explanation: NGFW dapat menilai identitas aplikasi meski port tidak lazim. ACL berdasarkan port saja dapat melewatkan aplikasi yang berjalan di port berbeda.

questions.stem: An enterprise is working with a third party and needs to allow access between the internal networks of both parties for a secure file migration. The solution needs to ensure encryption is applied to all traffic that is traversing the networks. Which of the following solutions should most likely be implemented?
questions.explanation: IPsec site-to-site melindungi komunikasi jaringan internal dua pihak. Batasi rute dan trafik partner sesuai kebutuhan, termasuk setelah tunnel aktif.

questions.stem: An administrator has identified and fingerprinted specific files that will generate an alert if an attempt is made to email these files outside of the organization. Which of the following best describes the tool the administrator is using?
questions.explanation: Fingerprint file membantu DLP mengenali dokumen saat dipindah atau dikirim. Hash biasa bisa memeriksa kesamaan file persis tetapi tidak otomatis menegakkan kebijakan.

questions.stem: A software developer released a new application and is distributing application files via the developer's website. Which of the following should the developer post on the website to allow users to verify the integrity of the downloaded files?
questions.explanation: Membandingkan digest dari sumber tepercaya mendeteksi perubahan file. Signature menambah bukti asal saat signer dan rantainya tepercaya.

questions.stem: An organization wants to limit potential impact to its log-in database in the event of a breach. Which of the following options is the security team most likely to recommend?
questions.explanation: Hash password dengan KDF khusus dan salt per akun. Enkripsi reversibel menimbulkan risiko bila kunci terbuka; penyimpanan plaintext langsung membuka password.

questions.stem: An administrator finds that all user workstations and servers are displaying a message that is associated with files containing an extension of .ryk. Which of the following types of infections is present on the systems?
questions.explanation: Ransom note dengan gangguan akses file merupakan indikator ransomware. Korelasikan tanda tersebut dengan perubahan file dan proses sebelum menyimpulkan cakupan.
Log menunjukkan trafik masuk serentak dari banyak sumber ke layanan yang bermasalah. Ini mendukung dugaan DDoS; window log yang kecil masih perlu dicek bersama laju trafik dan kesehatan backend.

questions.stem: An organization would like to calculate the time needed to resolve a hardware issue with a server. Which of the following risk management processes describes this example?
questions.explanation: MTTR adalah rerata waktu memperbaiki berdasarkan kejadian. RTO adalah target downtime, RPO target kehilangan data, MTBF rerata waktu antar kegagalan.

questions.stem:
A security engineer is installing an IPS to block signature-based attacks in the environment.

Which of the following modes will best accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: IPS disebut active karena dapat mencegah trafik berbahaya secara inline. IDS pasif umumnya memberi alert untuk tindakan lanjutan.

questions.stem: An IT manager is increasing the security capabilities of an organization after a data classification initiative determined that sensitive data could be exfiltrated from the environment. Which of the following solutions would mitigate the risk?
questions.explanation: DLP mengidentifikasi dan mengendalikan pengiriman data sensitif. XDR menggabungkan deteksi lintas sumber; SPF/DMARC membantu autentikasi email.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to protect a computer from viruses, malware, and Trojans being installed and moving laterally across the network?
questions.explanation: EDR memantau perilaku endpoint dan mendukung respons; produksi sering memasangkannya dengan EPP untuk pencegahan malware. SIEM mengorelasikan log yang diterima.

questions.stem: Client files can only be accessed by employees who need to know the information and have specified roles in the company. Which of the following best describes this security concept?
questions.explanation: Hak baca berbasis need-to-know menjaga confidentiality. Menjaga isi dari perubahan tidak sah adalah integrity; menjaga akses ketika dibutuhkan adalah availability.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the category of data that is most impacted when it is lost?
questions.explanation: Critical berarti kehilangan data dapat menghentikan fungsi utama. Sensitive menekankan dampak kebocoran; kategori dapat bertumpang tindih.

questions.stem: A new employee logs in to the email system for the first time and notices a message from human resources about onboarding. The employee hovers over a few of the links within the email and discovers that the links do not correspond to links associated with the company. Which of the following attack vectors is most likely being used?
questions.explanation: Pesan yang menyamar sebagai HR untuk memperoleh tindakan kerja mengarah ke BEC. Phishing lebih luas dan sering memakai halaman login palsu atau lampiran.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the understanding between a company and a client about what will be provided and the accepted time needed to provide the company with the resources?
questions.explanation: SLA menjelaskan standar layanan dan tanggung jawab saat target gagal. SOW merinci pekerjaan; NDA membatasi pengungkapan.

questions.stem: A company that is located in an area prone to hurricanes is developing a disaster recovery plan and looking at site considerations that allow the company to immediately continue operations. Which of the following is the best type of site for this company?
questions.explanation: Hot site relevan ketika fasilitas cadangan harus cepat mengambil alih. Warm membutuhkan restore atau aktivasi; cold membutuhkan provisioning; lokasi terpisah tetap penting.

questions.stem: Which of the following security controls is most likely being used when a critical legacy server is segmented into a private network?
questions.explanation: Segmentasi melindungi server legacy ketika patch atau kontrol standar belum tersedia. Tekniknya technical; tujuannya compensating.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the practice of researching laws and regulations related to information security operations within a specific industry?
questions.explanation: Due diligence berarti memeriksa kewajiban dan risiko sebelum mengambil keputusan. Gap analysis membandingkan kondisi dengan persyaratan yang sudah ditetapkan.

questions.stem: Which of the following considerations is the most important for an organization to evaluate as it establishes and maintains a data privacy program?
options: Reporting structure for the data privacy officer
Request process for data subject access
Role as a controller or processor
questions.explanation: Controller menentukan tujuan dan cara pemrosesan; processor menjalankan pemrosesan atas instruksi. Pembagian peran memengaruhi tanggung jawab dan kontrak.

questions.stem: A security analyst is investigating a workstation that is suspected of outbound communication to a command-and-control server. During the investigation, the analyst discovered that logs on the endpoint were deleted. Which of the following logs would the analyst most likely look at next?
questions.explanation: Firewall log memberi alamat tujuan, port, waktu dan hasil kebijakan. EDR bisa menautkan koneksi ke proses; DNS log memberi domain.

questions.stem: An IT manager is putting together a documented plan describing how the organization will keep operating in the event of a global incident. Which of the following plans is the IT manager creating?
questions.explanation: BCP menjaga proses bisnis tetap berjalan, termasuk personel dan cara kerja alternatif. DRP berfokus pada pemulihan teknologi.

questions.stem: A business needs a recovery site but does not require immediate failover. The business also wants to reduce the workload required to recover from an outage. Which of the following recovery sites is the best option?
questions.explanation: Peralatan standby dengan kebutuhan aktivasi dan tanpa failover langsung cocok dengan warm. Cold lebih banyak setup; hot menekan waktu berpindah.

questions.stem: A security team is setting up a new environment for hosting the organization's on-premises software application as a cloud-based service. Which of the following should the team ensure is in place in order for the organization to follow security best practices?
questions.explanation: Virtualisasi dan boundary isolasi memungkinkan beberapa beban kerja pada infrastruktur bersama. Penguatan hypervisor dan jaringan tetap dibutuhkan.

questions.stem: A manager receives an email that contains a link to receive a refund. After hovering over the link, the manager notices that the domain's URL points to a suspicious link. Which of the following security practices helped the manager to identify the attack?
questions.explanation: Kebiasaan memeriksa tujuan link dan melaporkan email terbentuk lewat pelatihan pengguna. Filter membantu mengurangi paparan sebelum email dibuka.

questions.stem: A company wants to verify that the software the company is deploying came from the vendor the company purchased the software from. Which of the following is the best way for the company to confirm this information?
options: Execute the code in a sandbox
Search the executable for ASCII strings
Generate a hash of the files
