questions.explanation: Verifikasi code signature terhadap signer tepercaya membuktikan asal dan integritas paket. Hash saja memerlukan digest pembanding yang dipercaya.

questions.stem: A systems administrator notices that one of the systems critical for processing customer transactions is running an end-of-life operating system. Which of the following techniques would increase enterprise security?
options: Placing the system in an isolated VLAN
questions.explanation: VLAN terisolasi, dengan aturan antarsegmen yang sesuai, membatasi akses ke sistem kritis. Segmentasi memberi kontrol kompensasi sementara.

questions.stem: The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) at a large company would like to gain an understanding of how the company's security policies compare to the requirements imposed by external regulators. Which of the following should the CISO use?
questions.explanation: Internal audit memeriksa apakah proses dan kontrol internal sesuai kriteria dan berjalan. Penilaian eksternal memberi jaminan yang lebih independen.

questions.stem: A systems administrator notices that the research and development department is not using the company VPN when accessing various company-related services and systems. Which of the following scenarios describes this activity?
questions.explanation: Menggunakan layanan di luar jalur yang disetujui mengarah ke shadow IT pada konteks soal. Melewati VPN sendiri tidak cukup jika akses langsung memang diotorisasi.

questions.stem: The marketing department set up its own project management software without telling the appropriate departments. Which of the following describes this scenario?
questions.explanation: Software pengelolaan proyek tanpa persetujuan IT adalah shadow IT. Motif tim bisa produktivitas; risiko muncul dari data dan akses tanpa pengawasan.

questions.stem: Which of the following would best explain why a security analyst is running daily vulnerability scans on all corporate endpoints?
options: To track the status of patching installations
To find shadow IT cloud deployment
To continuously the monitor hardware inventory
To hunt for active attackers in the network
questions.explanation: Scan berulang menunjukkan perubahan status patch dan temuan yang kembali muncul. Verifikasi versi serta exposure untuk menghindari false positive.

questions.stem: Which of the following is classified as high availability in a cloud environment?
questions.explanation: Load balancer membagi trafik ke target sehat untuk menjaga availability. Untuk kegagalan lokasi, backend dan dependensi perlu tersebar.

questions.stem: Which of the following security measures is required when using a cloud-based platform for IoT management?
questions.explanation: Enkripsi kanal melindungi data dan identitas perangkat IoT saat transit. Autentikasi perangkat dan pengelolaan sertifikat menambah perlindungan.

questions.stem: Which of the following threat vectors is most commonly utilized by insider threat actors attempting data exfiltration?
options: Impersonation of business units throught typosquatting
questions.explanation: Perangkat lepas dapat membawa salinan data keluar dari pengawasan jaringan. DLP endpoint dan kebijakan media membantu mendeteksi atau membatasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following methods to secure credit card data is best to use when a requirement is to see only the last four numbers on a credit card?
questions.explanation: Masking menampilkan sebagian nomor sesuai kebutuhan, misalnya digit terakhir. Tokenization mengganti nilai untuk pemrosesan; enkripsi menjaga isi dengan kunci.

questions.stem: The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) has determined the company is non-compliant with local data privacy regulations. The CISO needs to justify the budget request for more resources. Which of the following should the CISO present to the board as the direct consequence of non-compliance?
questions.explanation: Denda dapat menjadi konsekuensi ketidakpatuhan, tergantung yurisdiksi dan keputusan otoritas. Audit findings, remediasi dan reputasi merupakan konsekuensi yang berbeda.

questions.stem: Which of the following alert types is the most likely to be ignored over time?
questions.explanation: False positive yang sering terjadi menciptakan alert fatigue. Tuning setelah investigasi mengurangi noise sambil menjaga cakupan deteksi.

questions.stem: A security analyst is investigating an application server and discovers that software on the server is behaving abnormally. The software normally runs batch jobs locally and does not generate traffic, but the process is now generating outbound traffic over random high ports. Which of the following vulnerabilities has likely been exploited in this software?
questions.explanation: Perilaku baru pada proses tanpa perubahan sah mendukung dugaan memory injection di pilihan soal. Validasi dengan telemetri proses; anomali jaringan sendiri tidak membuktikannya.

questions.stem: An important patch for a critical application has just been released, and a systems administrator is identifying all of the systems requiring the patch. Which of the following must be maintained in order to ensure that all systems requiring the patch are updated?
questions.explanation: Inventaris menunjukkan instalasi, owner, versi dan dependensi untuk deployment patch. Scan mengonfirmasi temuan dan hasil perbaikan.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a security operations center use to improve its incident response procedure?
questions.explanation: Playbook menyediakan langkah dan keputusan untuk jenis insiden tertentu. IRP menetapkan struktur, otoritas dan komunikasi tingkat organisasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes an executive team that is meeting in a board room and testing the company's incident response plan?
questions.explanation: Diskusi berbasis skenario di ruang rapat adalah tabletop. Simulasi teknis menjalankan langkah atau alat dan menghasilkan bukti waktu.

questions.stem: A healthcare organization wants to provide a web application that allows individuals to digitally report health emergencies. Which of the following is the most important consideration during development?
questions.explanation: Ketika fungsi utama ialah dapat diakses saat diperlukan, tujuannya availability. Akses yang andal berjalan bersama kontrol confidentiality dan integrity.

questions.stem: Which of the following agreement types defines the time frame in which a vendor needs to respond?
questions.explanation: SLA menentukan waktu respons atau pemulihan layanan. SOW menetapkan durasi pengerjaan proyek dan deliverable.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a feature of a next-generation SIEM system?
questions.explanation: SIEM modern dapat memicu respons otomatis, umumnya lewat kemampuan terintegrasi. SOAR berfokus pada orkestrasi dan persetujuan tindakan lintas alat.

questions.stem: To improve the security at a data center, a security administrator implements a CCTV system and posts several signs about the possibility of being filmed. Which of the following best describe these types of controls? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Kamera merekam kejadian untuk deteksi; tanda dan kamera terlihat membantu deter. Pencegahan fisik langsung memerlukan penghalang atau pembatas akses.

questions.stem: Which of the following examples would be best mitigated by input sanitization?
options: A script tag submitted through a form input
Email message: "Click this link to get your free gift card."
Browser message: "Your connection is not private."
questions.explanation: Input berupa konten aktif diarahkan ke sanitasi yang cocok. Untuk XSS, encode output sesuai konteks; pengujian jaringan atau masalah sertifikat membutuhkan kontrol berbeda.

questions.stem: An attacker posing as the Chief Executive Officer calls an employee and instructs the employee to buy gift cards. Which of the following techniques is the attacker using?
questions.explanation: Berpura-pura sebagai CEO adalah impersonation; media telepon juga cocok disebut vishing. Nama teknik dan kanal bisa sama-sama benar bila pertanyaannya berbeda.

questions.stem: After conducting a vulnerability scan, a systems administrator notices that one of the identified vulnerabilities is not present on the systems that were scanned. Which of the following describes this example?
questions.explanation: False positive berarti temuan terlapor ternyata tidak ada. Temuan nyata yang terlindungi firewall tetap kelemahan dengan exposure lebih kecil.

questions.stem: A recent penetration test identified that an attacker could flood the MAC address table of network switches. Which of the following would best mitigate this type of attack?
questions.explanation: Port security membatasi alamat MAC yang dapat dipelajari per port. 802.1X menambah autentikasi; segmentasi menata akses antar jaringan.

questions.stem: A user would like to install software and features that are not available with a smartphone's default software. Which of the following would allow the user to install unauthorized software and enable new features?
questions.explanation: Jailbreak mengubah batas platform agar fitur yang dibatasi tersedia. Sideloading menambah software melalui jalur lain dan berbeda dari perubahan hak OS.

questions.stem: Which of the following phases of an incident response involves generating reports?
questions.explanation: Laporan retrospektif dan perbaikan program termasuk lessons learned. Dokumentasikan bukti dan keputusan selama seluruh insiden, bukan hanya saat penutupan.

questions.stem: Which of the following methods would most likely be used to identify legacy systems?
questions.explanation: Scan dapat mengidentifikasi versi atau sistem lama yang terjangkau. Inventaris mencakup aset yang saat scan tidak aktif atau tidak terjangkau.

questions.stem: Employees located off-site must have access to company resources in order to complete their assigned tasks. These employees utilize a solution that allows remote access without interception concerns. Which of the following best describes this solution?
questions.explanation: VPN memberi tunnel ke resource dari luar lokasi. ZTNA biasanya memberi akses yang lebih sempit per aplikasi; keduanya perlu otorisasi.

questions.stem: A company allows customers to upload PDF documents to its public e-commerce website. Which of the following would a security analyst most likely recommend?
options: Utilizing attack signatures in an IDS
Enabling malware detection through a UTM
Limiting the affected servers with a load balancer
Blocking command injections via a WAF
questions.explanation: UTM dengan scanning malware membantu menahan file berbahaya sesuai opsi. Aplikasi juga perlu pembatasan tipe, ukuran, lokasi penyimpanan, dan pemrosesan file yang aman.

questions.stem: A security analyst developed a script to automate a trivial and repeatable task. Which of the following best describes the benefits of ensuring other team members understand how the script works?
options: To prevent a single point of failure
questions.explanation: Dokumentasi dan review mencegah proses bergantung pada satu pembuat skrip. Untuk sistem produksi, atur monitoring, pemilik cadangan, dan jalur pemulihan.

questions.stem: A company is decommissioning its physical servers and replacing them with an architecture that will reduce the number of individual operating systems. Which of the following strategies should the company use to achieve this security requirement?
questions.explanation: Containerisasi memaketkan dependensi dan mengurangi overhead OS guest per layanan. VM menyertakan guest OS dan biasanya memberi batas isolasi tambahan.

questions.stem: An administrator needs to perform server hardening before deployment. Which of the following steps should the administrator take? (Choose two.)
options: Add the server to the asset inventory
Send server logs to the SIEM
Join the server to the corporate domain
questions.explanation: Menonaktifkan akun bawaan dan layanan yang tidak perlu mengurangi jalur akses. Terapkan baseline, patch, dan verifikasi setelah deployment.

questions.stem: A Chief Information Security Officer would like to conduct frequent, detailed reviews of systems and procedures to track compliance objectives. Which of the following will be the best method to achieve this objective?
questions.explanation: Internal audit cocok untuk evaluasi detail yang rutin. External audit menambah independensi tetapi dijadwalkan menurut kebutuhan assurance.

questions.stem: Which of the following security concepts is accomplished with the installation of a RADIUS server?
questions.explanation: RADIUS mendukung AAA, khususnya akses jaringan. Authentication memeriksa identitas, authorization memberi hak, accounting mencatat penggunaan.

questions.stem: After creating a contract for IT contractors, the human resources department changed several clauses. The contract has gone through three revisions. Which of the following processes should the human resources department follow to track revisions?
questions.explanation: Version control menyimpan revisi, siapa mengubah dan perbedaan antarversi. Approval menilai apakah versi baru boleh diberlakukan.

questions.stem: The executive management team is mandating the company develop a disaster recovery plan. The cost must be kept to a minimum, and the money to fund additional internet connections is not available. Which of the following would be the best option?
questions.explanation: Prioritas biaya minimum mendorong cold site. Kapasitas koneksi dan perangkat mungkin perlu diadakan ketika aktif; pastikan toleransi downtime memadai.

questions.stem: An administrator at a small business notices an increase in support calls from employees who receive a blocked page message after trying to navigate to a spoofed website. Which of the following should the administrator do?
options: Decrease the level of the web filter settings
questions.explanation: Pelatihan mengajari cara mengenali dan melapor pesan palsu yang memicu panggilan dukungan. Kontrol teknis dapat melengkapi, tergantung vektor.

questions.stem: Which of the following teams is best suited to determine whether a company has systems that can be exploited by a potential, identified vulnerability?
questions.explanation: Red team mensimulasikan perilaku lawan secara terotorisasi untuk menilai pertahanan. Blue team melihat deteksi dan respons; purple menyatukan umpan balik.

questions.stem:
A company is reviewing options to enforce user logins after several account takeovers. The following conditions must be met as part of the solution:

• Allow employees to work remotely or from assigned offices around the world.
• Provide a seamless login experience.
• Limit the amount of equipment required.

Which of the following best meets these conditions?
questions.explanation: Trusted device mengikat keputusan akses pada perangkat yang disetujui atau compliant. MFA menilai faktor tambahan; conditional access menggabungkan keduanya.

questions.stem: Which of the following methods can be used to detect attackers who have successfully infiltrated a network? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Honeypot menghasilkan sinyal ketika resource umpan disentuh. DNS sinkhole mengalihkan resolusi domain berbahaya dan memberi telemetri perangkat yang mencoba menghubungi.

questions.stem: A company wants to ensure that the software it develops will not be tampered with after the final version is completed. Which of the following should the company most likely use?
questions.explanation: Hash yang diketahui dapat memverifikasi integritas file rilis. Untuk menjamin asal digest dan publisher, gunakan signature atau kanal tepercaya.

questions.stem: An organization completed a project to deploy SSO across all business applications last year. Recently, the finance department selected a new cloud-based accounting software vendor. Which of the following should most likely be configured during the new software deployment?
questions.explanation: SAML membawa assertion identitas yang ditandatangani untuk federasi SSO. OAuth mengatur delegasi akses; OIDC menambahkan identitas di atas OAuth.

questions.stem: A user, who is waiting for a flight at an airport, logs in to the airline website using the public Wi-Fi, ignores a security warning and purchases an upgraded seat. When the flight lands, the user finds unauthorized credit card charges. Which of the following attacks most likely occurred?
questions.explanation: Jaringan publik memberi konteks risiko on-path. Validasi sertifikat TLS membatasi penyadapan dan perubahan; keberadaan Wi-Fi publik sendiri tidak membuktikan serangan.

questions.stem: A network engineer deployed a redundant switch stack to increase system availability. However, the budget can only cover the cost of one ISP connection. Which of the following best describes the potential risk factor?
options: An RPO has not been determined
There is a single point of failure
questions.explanation: Switch redundan tetap memiliki SPOF jika bergantung pada satu komponen seperti listrik atau uplink. Inventaris dependensi bersama sebelum menyatakan HA.

questions.stem: A network team segmented a critical, end-of-life server to a VLAN that can only be reached by specific devices but cannot be reached by the perimeter network. Which of the following best describe the controls the team implemented? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: VLAN dan pembatasan jalur adalah kontrol technical. Perannya compensating ketika melindungi server yang tidak dapat memakai kontrol biasa.

questions.stem: A threat actor was able to use a username and password to log in to a stolen company mobile device. Which of the following provides the best solution to increase mobile data security on all employees' company mobile devices?
questions.explanation: Remote wipe membatasi paparan data setelah perangkat hilang. Efektivitas bergantung pada perangkat menerima perintah; enkripsi dan revoke token menambah lapisan.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the risk present after controls and mitigating factors have been applied?
questions.explanation: Residual risk adalah risiko setelah kontrol. Inherent risk dinilai sebelum pengaruh kontrol; accepted risk memerlukan keputusan pihak berwenang.

questions.stem: A software development team asked a security administrator to recommend techniques that should be used to reduce the chances of the software being reverse engineered. Which of the following should the security administrator recommend?
options: Limiting the use of third-party libraries
questions.explanation: Obfuscation memperlambat pemahaman kode. Integrity dijaga signature, akses menjaga rahasia, dan secret server-side tidak perlu ikut dibundel ke client.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a possible factor for MFA?
questions.explanation: Token atau kunci yang dipegang merupakan possession. Password knowledge, biometrik inherence, lokasi dan perangkat dapat menjadi sinyal konteks.

questions.stem: Easy-to-guess passwords led to an account compromise. The current password policy requires at least 12 alphanumeric characters, one uppercase character, one lowercase character, a password history of two passwords, a minimum password age of one day, and a maximum password age of 90 days. Which of the following would reduce the risk of this incident from happening again? (Choose two.)
options: Increasing the minimum password length to 14 characters.
Upgrading the password hashing algorithm from MD5 to SHA-512.
Increasing the maximum password age to 120 days.
Reducing the minimum password length to ten characters.
Reducing the minimum password age to zero days.
Including a requirement for at least one special character.
questions.explanation: Bank memilih panjang dan karakter khusus sebagai opsi perubahan. Untuk kebijakan modern, prioritaskan panjang, blocklist password bocor, rate limiting dan MFA; aturan komposisi tidak otomatis menambah kekuatan yang efektif.

questions.stem: A user downloaded software from an online forum. After the user installed the software, the security team observed external network traffic connecting to the user's computer on an uncommon port. Which of the following is the most likely explanation of this unauthorized connection?
options: The software had a hidden keylogger.
The user's computer had a fileless virus.
questions.explanation: Backdoor memberi jalur akses tersembunyi yang bisa tetap ada setelah instalasi. Trojan menggambarkan penyamaran program; backdoor menggambarkan fungsinya.

questions.stem:
A utility company is designing a new platform that will host all the virtual machines used by business applications. The requirements include:

• A starting baseline of 50% memory utilization
• Storage scalability
• Single circuit failure resilience

Which of the following best meets all of these requirements?
options: Connecting dual PDUs to redundant power supplies
Transitioning the platform to an IaaS provider
Configuring network load balancing for multiple paths
Deploying multiple large NAS devices for each host
questions.explanation: IaaS memindahkan pengelolaan host fisik ke provider sambil pelanggan mengelola VM. PaaS mengelola lebih banyak runtime; SaaS menyajikan aplikasi jadi.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes a use case for a DNS sinkhole?
options: Attackers can see a DNS sinkhole as a highly valuable resource to identify a company's domain structure.
A DNS sinkhole can be used to draw employees away from known-good websites to malicious ones owned by the attacker.
A DNS sinkhole can be used to capture traffic to known-malicious domains used by attackers.
A DNS sinkhole can be set up to attract potential attackers away from a company's network resources.
questions.explanation: Sinkhole mengarahkan nama domain berbahaya ke tujuan aman untuk memutus koneksi dan melihat sumber permintaan. Filtering biasa bisa langsung menolak resolusi.

questions.stem: An incident analyst finds several image files on a hard disk. The image files may contain geolocation coordinates. Which of the following best describes the type of information the analyst is trying to extract from the image files?
questions.explanation: Metadata gambar seperti EXIF dapat menyimpan koordinat. Nilai dapat dihapus atau diubah; verifikasi dengan data pendukung.

questions.stem: Which of the following most likely describes why a security engineer would configure all outbound emails to use S/MIME digital signatures?
questions.explanation: Signature pada email memberi bukti pengirim dan integritas relatif terhadap kunci tepercaya. Enkripsi melindungi isi dan menjawab kebutuhan lain.

questions.stem: During a recent company safety stand-down, the cyber-awareness team gave a presentation on the importance of cyber hygiene. One topic the team covered was best practices for printing centers. Which of the following describes an attack method that relates to printing centers?
questions.explanation: Dumpster diving mencari informasi sensitif dari media yang dibuang. Atur shredding atau sanitasi sesuai jenis media.

questions.stem: Which of the following considerations is the most important regarding cryptography used in an IoT device?
options: The compatibility of the TLS version
questions.explanation: IoT sering punya batas daya, memori dan CPU. Gunakan protokol dan algoritma yang didukung dengan profil teruji, sambil mengelola perangkat sepanjang lifecycle.

questions.stem: A coffee shop owner wants to restrict internet access to only paying customers by prompting them for a receipt number. Which of the following is the best method to use given this requirement?
questions.explanation: Captive portal menampilkan syarat atau autentikasi sebelum akses internet. Pisahkan guest network; portal bukan pengganti enkripsi link Wi-Fi.

questions.stem: While performing digital forensics, which of the following is considered the most volatile and should have the contents collected first?
questions.explanation: RAM cepat berubah dan hilang saat daya mati. Prioritas akuisisi mengikuti volatilitas, keamanan personel, scope, dan kebutuhan containment.

questions.stem: A hosting provider needs to prove that its security controls have been in place over the last six months and have sufficiently protected customer data. Which of the following would provide the best proof that the hosting provider has met the requirements?
questions.explanation: SOC 2 Type 2 menilai desain dan efektivitas operasi selama periode. Type 1 menilai desain kontrol pada satu waktu.

questions.stem: A city municipality lost its primary data center when a tornado hit the facility. Which of the following should the city staff use immediately after the disaster to handle essential public services?
questions.explanation: DRP menata pemulihan IT setelah lokasi primer hilang. BCP menjaga fungsi bisnis selama proses tersebut dan bisa memakai cara alternatif.

questions.stem: Which of the following is considered a preventive control?
questions.explanation: Segregation of duties mengharuskan lebih dari satu pihak mengerjakan atau menyetujui tindakan sensitif. Audit log setelah kejadian berfungsi detective.
Jawaban bank adalah DoS. Cari penurunan respons atau habisnya kapasitas pada lampiran. Jamming berkaitan interferensi radio; ARP poisoning mengubah pemetaan jaringan lokal.

questions.stem: A security team has been alerted to a flood of incoming emails that have various subject lines and are addressed to multiple email inboxes. Each email contains a URL shortener link that is redirecting to a dead domain. Which of the following is the best step for the security team to take?
options: Create a blocklist for all subject lines
Send the dead domain to a DNS sinkhole
Quarantine all emails received and notify all employees
Block the URL shortener domain in the web proxy
questions.explanation: Pemblokiran domain shortener di proxy menurunkan akses ke pengalihan yang dipakai kampanye. Pertimbangkan dampak bisnis dan gunakan IOC yang terverifikasi.

questions.stem: A security administrator is working to secure company data on corporate laptops in case the laptops are stolen. Which of the following solutions should the administrator consider?
questions.explanation: Enkripsi disk menekan risiko pencurian data dari laptop. Kunci pemulihan perlu dikelola; sesi yang sudah terbuka tetap memerlukan proteksi akses.

questions.stem: A company needs to keep the fewest records possible, meet compliance needs, and ensure destruction of records that are no longer needed. Which of the following best describes the policy that meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: Retention policy menentukan periode simpan dan pemusnahan sesuai kebutuhan dan kewajiban. Legal hold dapat menunda penghapusan item terkait.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a common source of unintentional corporate credential leakage in cloud environments?
questions.explanation: Secrets di repo dapat ikut tersebar melalui clone, riwayat atau log CI. Rotasi secret yang bocor dan gunakan secret manager.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best reason an organization should enforce a data classification policy to help protect its most sensitive information?
options: End users will be required to consider the classification of data that can be used in documents.
The policy will result in the creation of access levels for each level of classification.
The organization will have the ability to create security requirements based on classification levels.
Security analysts will be able to see the classification of data within a document before opening it.
questions.explanation: Klasifikasi memungkinkan persyaratan perlindungan sesuai kelas. Kebijakan teknis seperti DLP, enkripsi, dan retensi mengikuti hasil klasifikasi.

questions.stem: An analyst is performing a vulnerability scan against the web servers exposed to the internet without a system account. Which of the following is most likely being performed?
questions.explanation: Non-credentialed scan melihat permukaan yang dapat dijangkau tanpa akun. Credentialed scan melihat konfigurasi dan patch dari dalam dengan izin yang sesuai.

questions.stem: A security administrator is hardening corporate systems and applying appropriate mitigations by consulting a real-world knowledge base for adversary behavior. Which of the following would be best for the administrator to reference?
questions.explanation: MITRE ATT&CK mengorganisasi taktik dan teknik untuk membantu pemetaan deteksi serta mitigasi. CVSS mengukur severity kelemahan; OWASP memetakan risiko aplikasi.

questions.stem: An architect has a request to increase the speed of data transfer using JSON requests externally. Currently, the organization uses SFTP to transfer data files. Which of the following will most likely meet the requirements?
questions.explanation: Microservices memisahkan fungsi ke layanan API dan memungkinkan scaling terpisah. Latensi tidak otomatis turun; ukur kebutuhan jaringan, serialisasi dan dependensi.

questions.stem: Which of the following addresses individual rights such as the right to be informed, the right of access, and the right to be forgotten?
questions.explanation: GDPR mengatur hak subjek data dan kewajiban terkait dalam cakupannya. Hak serta pengecualian bergantung pada jenis data dan dasar pemrosesan.

questions.stem: An administrator is installing an LDAP browser tool in order to view objects in the corporate LDAP directory. Secure connections to the LDAP server are required. When the browser connects to the server, certificate errors are being displayed, and then the connection is terminated. Which of the following is the most likely solution?
options: The administrator should allow SAN certificates in the browser configuration.
The administrator needs to install the server certificate into the local truststore.
The administrator should request that the secure LDAP port be opened to the server.
The administrator needs to increase the TLS version on the organization's RA.
questions.explanation: Kepercayaan LDAPS memerlukan rantai sertifikat yang dipercaya. Jika layanan memakai CA internal, biasanya impor root CA yang sah; pinning leaf memerlukan prosedur rotasi tersendiri.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most important security concern when using legacy systems to provide production service?
questions.explanation: Hilangnya vendor support berarti patch dan dukungan sulit diperoleh. Segmentasi membantu sementara dan harus disertai rencana penggantian.

questions.stem: A security investigation revealed that malicious software was installed on a server using a server administrator's credentials. During the investigation, the server administrator explained that Telnet was regularly used to log in. Which of the following most likely occurred?
options: A spraying attack was used to determine which credentials to use.
A packet capture tool was used to steal the password.
A remote-access Trojan was used to install the malware.
A dictionary attack was used to log in as the server administrator.
questions.explanation: Kunci mengasumsikan kredensial dilewatkan tanpa proteksi sehingga terlihat pada trafik. Capture tidak otomatis membuka sesi yang terenkripsi dan tervalidasi.

questions.stem: A user is requesting Telnet access to manage a remote development web server. Insecure protocols are not allowed for use within any environment. Which of the following should be configured to allow remote access to this server?
questions.explanation: SSH menyediakan administrasi jarak jauh dengan kanal terenkripsi. Telnet umumnya cleartext; HTTPS melindungi web, bukan shell admin.

questions.stem: A security administrator is working to find a cost-effective solution to implement certificates for a large number of domains and subdomains owned by the company. Which of the following types of certificates should the administrator implement?
questions.explanation: Wildcard menghemat pengelolaan sertifikat untuk beberapa hostname pada satu tingkat subdomain. SAN dapat mendaftarkan nama tertentu; berbagi private key memperbesar dampak kebocoran.

questions.stem: An auditor discovered multiple insecure ports on some servers. Other servers were found to have legacy protocols enabled. Which of the following tools did the auditor use to discover these issues?
questions.explanation: Nessus mengidentifikasi layanan, konfigurasi dan kelemahan yang terdeteksi. Packet analyzer menganalisis trafik; inventory memastikan cakupan aset.

questions.stem:
A security analyst received a tip that sensitive proprietary information was leaked to the public. The analyst is reviewing the PCAP and notices traffic between an internal server and an external host that includes the following:

...
12:47:22.327233 PPPoE [ses 0x8122] IP (tos 0x0, ttl 64, id 0, offset 0, flags [DF], proto IPv6 (41), length 331) 10.5.1.1 > 52.165.16.154: IP6 (hlim E3, next-header TCP (6) paylcad length: 271) 2001:67c:2158:a019::ace.53104 > 2001:0:5ef5:79fd:380c:dddd:a601:24fa.13788: Flags [P.], cksum 0xd7ee (correct), seq 97:348, ack 102, win 16444, length 251
...

Which of the following was most likely used to exfiltrate the data?
questions.explanation: Encapsulation membungkus data dalam protokol lain. Tunneling dapat sah; pada insiden ini periksa jenis trafik, tujuan, volume, dan sumber proses.

questions.stem: A company wants to reduce the time and expense associated with code deployment. Which of the following technologies should the company utilize?
questions.explanation: Serverless mendelegasikan pengelolaan runtime dasar dan infrastruktur ke provider. Tim tetap mengelola kode, izin, log, data serta batas biaya.

questions.stem:
A security administrator is performing an audit on a stand-alone UNIX server, and the following message is immediately displayed:

(Error 13): /etc/shadow: Permission denied.

Which of the following best describes the type of tool that is being used?
questions.explanation: Bank mengaitkan pesan audit dengan password cracker. Ini menunjukkan aktivitas tebakan kredensial; periksa sumber, scope akun, dan keberhasilan login sebelum menarik kesimpulan.

questions.stem: A security administrator needs to create firewall rules for the following protocols: RTP, SIP, H.323. and SRTP. Which of the following does this rule set support?
questions.explanation: SIP dan H.323 berkaitan dengan pengaturan panggilan; RTP membawa media. ACL perlu kebutuhan trafik yang terkonfirmasi dan jalur media yang benar.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes a social engineering attack that uses a targeted electronic messaging campaign aimed at a Chief Executive Officer?
questions.explanation: Whaling menargetkan eksekutif atau jabatan bernilai tinggi. Spear phishing berarti sangat tertarget secara umum; smishing dan vishing mengacu kanal.

questions.stem: During a penetration test, a flaw in the internal PKI was exploited to gain domain administrator rights using specially crafted certificates. Which of the following remediation tasks should be completed as part of the cleanup phase?
questions.explanation: CRL menyampaikan sertifikat yang dicabut kepada relying party. Patch CA menangani akar masalah; proses respons perlu mengidentifikasi sertifikat terdampak dan memverifikasi pencabutan.

questions.stem: A company wants to implement MFA. Which of the following enables the additional factor while using a smart card?
questions.explanation: Smart card adalah possession; PIN adalah knowledge yang membuka penggunaan kartu. Dua credential dari faktor yang sama tidak otomatis menjadi MFA.

questions.stem: A company hired an external consultant to assist with required system upgrades to a critical business application. A systems administrator needs to secure the consultant's access without sharing passwords to critical systems. Which of the following solutions should most likely be utilized?
questions.explanation: PAM memberi hak administratif terbatas waktu dan dapat merekam sesi konsultan. SSO mengurangi login berulang; RBAC menetapkan hak lewat role.

questions.stem: A newly implemented wireless network is designed so that visitors can connect to the wireless network for business activities. The legal department is concerned that visitors might connect to the network and perform illicit activities. Which of me following should the security team implement to address this concern?
options: Configure a RADIUS server to manage device authentication.
Use 802.1X on all devices connecting to wireless.
Add a guest captive portal requiring visitors to accept terms and conditions.
Allow for new devices to be connected via WPS.
questions.explanation: Captive portal membuat pengunjung menyetujui syarat sebelum Internet. Isolasi guest dan kontrol Wi-Fi menangani akses ke jaringan internal dan privasi link.

questions.stem: Which of the following data roles is responsible for identifying risks and appropriate access to data?
questions.explanation: Controller menentukan tujuan dan cara pemrosesan, termasuk kebijakan akses. Custodian menjalankan proteksi, processor bekerja atas instruksi, subject adalah orang terkait.

questions.stem: Which of the following physical controls can be used to both detect and deter? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Sensor memberi sinyal; cahaya dapat membuat aktivitas terlihat dan mengurangi upaya masuk diam-diam. Efek deter sensor lebih jelas jika keberadaannya diketahui.

questions.stem: A multinational bank hosts several servers in its data center. These servers run a business-critical application used by customers to access their account information. Which of the following should the bank use to ensure accessibility during peak usage times?
questions.explanation: Load balancer membagi trafik dan mengeluarkan backend gagal dari rotasi. Pastikan balancer, penyimpanan dan dependensi juga tahan gagal.

questions.stem: The author of a software package is concerned about bad actors repackaging and inserting malware into the software. The software download is hosted on a website, and the author exclusively controls the website's contents. Which of the following techniques would best ensure the software's integrity?
questions.explanation: Signature membuat repackaging terdeteksi saat pengguna memverifikasi signer yang dipercaya. Hash tanpa kanal tepercaya dapat diganti bersama paket.

questions.stem: A third-party vendor is moving a particular application to the end-of-life stage at the end of the current year. Which of the following is the most critical risk if the company chooses to continue running the application?
questions.explanation: Aplikasi di akhir lifecycle dapat kehilangan patch dan vendor support. Mitigasi sementara seperti isolasi perlu diikuti rencana migrasi.

questions.stem: A security analyst recently read a report about a flaw in several of the organization's printer models that causes credentials to be sent over the network in cleartext, regardless of the encryption settings. Which of the following would be best to use to validate this finding?
questions.explanation: Wireshark membaca capture untuk memeriksa protokol dan aliran yang terlihat. SIEM mengorelasikan event; packet capture terbatas ketika isi dienkripsi.

questions.stem: A development team is launching a new public-facing web product. The Chief Information Security Officer has asked that the product be protected from attackers who use malformed or invalid inputs to destabilize the system. Which of the following practices should the development team implement?
questions.explanation: Fuzzing menguji ketahanan terhadap input tak terduga dalam pengujian yang diotorisasi. SAST memeriksa sumber; review menilai desain dan perubahan. Jawaban analisis.

questions.stem: During an annual review of the system design, an engineer identified a few issues with the currently released design. Which of the following should be performed next according to best practices?
questions.explanation: Perubahan desain yang telah dirilis perlu change control, termasuk impact, persetujuan, pengujian, dan rollback. Version control melacak revisi.

questions.stem: Which of the following is best to use when determining the severity of a vulnerability?
questions.explanation: CVSS menyatakan tingkat keparahan. CVE mengidentifikasi kelemahan, dan prioritas organisasi juga dipengaruhi dampak aset serta exposure nyata.

questions.stem: An organization discovers fraudulent wire transfers from a hardened PC. During the incident review, an analyst finds a second PC with malware. Its command history shows a credential replay tool using a captured NTLM hash for a shared support account. Which of the following best describes how the attacker gained access to the hardened PC?
options: The attacker created fileless malware that was hosted by the banking platform.
The attacker performed a pass-the-hash attack using a shared support account.
The attacker utilized living-off-the-land binaries to evade endpoint detection and response software.
The attacker socially engineered the accountant into performing bad transfers.
questions.explanation: Skenario dan bank menunjuk penyalahgunaan material autentikasi melalui shared support account. Kurangi akun bersama, batasi hak admin, dan selidiki autentikasi serta aktivitas endpoint.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best resource to consult for information on the most common application exploitation methods?
questions.explanation: OWASP mengelompokkan risiko aplikasi dan menyediakan panduan pemeriksaan. MITRE ATT&CK memetakan perilaku lawan lintas tahap; CVSS menilai severity.

options: Determining the organization's ISP-assigned address space
Attempting to achieve initial access to the DNS server
questions.explanation: Log menunjukkan upaya transfer zona DNS internal. Ini cocok dengan footprinting karena data zona bisa mengungkap nama dan topologi. Cek apakah transfer diizinkan sebelum menyimpulkan data keluar.

questions.stem: A security analyst at an organization observed several user logins from outside the organization's network. The analyst determined that these logins were not performed by individuals within the organization. Which of the following recommendations would reduce the likelihood of future attacks? (Choose two.)
options: A review of user account permissions
questions.explanation: Conditional access menilai sinyal seperti lokasi, perangkat, dan risiko login. MFA menambah faktor; logging membantu investigasi tanpa dengan sendirinya menghentikan akses.

questions.stem: A security team is addressing a risk associated with the attack surface of the organization's web application over port 443. Currently, no advanced network security capabilities are in place. Which of the following would be best to set up? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: NIDS memberi visibilitas jaringan; WAF melindungi HTTP aplikasi. NIPS dapat memblokir inline. Pilih lapisan berdasarkan lokasi trafik dan tujuan.

questions.stem: A systems administrator would like to create a point-in-time backup of a virtual machine. Which of the following should the administrator use?
questions.explanation: Snapshot merekam keadaan VM pada satu titik. Backup terpisah melindungi jika storage sumber rusak; pastikan snapshot konsisten dengan aplikasi.

questions.stem: A security administrator notices numerous unused, non-compliant desktops are connected to the network. Which of the following actions would the administrator most likely recommend to the management team?
questions.explanation: Decommissioning mencabut aset yang tak dipakai, melepas akses, memperbarui inventaris, lalu menyanitasi data. Quarantine berguna bila aset perlu diselidiki.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a common data removal option for companies that want to wipe sensitive data from hard drives in a repeatable manner but allow the hard drives to be reused?
questions.explanation: Sanitization mengurangi kemungkinan data lama dapat dipulihkan. Wiping, purge dan destruction berbeda kemampuan serta dampaknya terhadap reuse.

questions.stem:
An organization wants to improve the company's security authentication method for remote employees. Given the following requirements:

• Must work across SaaS and internal network applications
• Must be device manufacturer agnostic
• Must have offline capabilities

Which of the following would be the most appropriate authentication method?
questions.explanation: Token berbasis waktu menampilkan kode sementara. Password tetap faktor knowledge, token menambah possession; autentikator terikat origin lebih tahan phishing.

questions.stem: A security officer is implementing a security awareness program and has placed security-themed posters around the building and assigned online user training. Which of the following will the security officer most likely implement?
questions.explanation: Poster menjaga kesadaran; simulasi phishing menguji perilaku dan pelaporan. Gunakan hasil agregat untuk memperbaiki pelatihan.

questions.stem: A malicious update was distributed to a common software platform and disabled services at many organizations. Which of the following best describes this type of vulnerability?
questions.explanation: Update vendor yang tercemar memanfaatkan hubungan kepercayaan rantai pasok. Review provenance, signature dan dampak perubahan pada pelanggan.

questions.stem: A company web server is initiating outbound traffic to a low-reputation, public IP on non-standard pat. The web server is used to present an unauthenticated page to clients who upload images the company. An analyst notices a suspicious process running on the server hat was not created by the company development team. Which of the following is the most likely explanation for his security incident?
options: A web shell has been deployed to the server through the page.
A vulnerability has been exploited to deploy a worm to the server.
Malicious insiders are using the server to mine cryptocurrency.
Attackers have deployed a rootkit Trojan to the server over an exposed RDP port.
questions.explanation: Koneksi keluar tidak biasa dari web server dan jejak upload mendukung dugaan web shell pada opsi. Telusuri proses, log aplikasi dan perubahan file untuk konfirmasi.

questions.stem: An organization requests a third-party full-spectrum analysis of its supply chain. Which of the following would the analysis team use to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Bank memilih SCAP, standar otomasi pemeriksaan teknis. Untuk due diligence rantai pasok komprehensif, kombinasikan bukti konfigurasi dengan audit vendor, kontrak dan dependensi.

questions.stem: A systems administrator deployed a monitoring solution that does not require installation on the endpoints that the solution is monitoring. Which of the following is described in this scenario?
questions.explanation: Agentless monitoring memakai antarmuka yang telah tersedia sehingga tidak memasang agen per endpoint. Agent dapat memberi konteks proses lebih mendalam.

questions.stem: A security analyst is reviewing the source code of an application in order to identify misconfigurations and vulnerabilities. Which of the following kinds of analysis best describes this review?
questions.explanation: Analisis statis menilai kode tanpa menjalankan aplikasi. Analisis dinamis memeriksa perilaku saat runtime; review manual membaca logika bisnis.

questions.stem: Which of the following agreement types is used to limit external discussions?
questions.explanation: NDA menetapkan informasi yang wajib dirahasiakan dan pengungkapan yang diizinkan. SLA, SOW, serta MSA mengatur aspek layanan dan pekerjaan.

questions.stem: A security analyst is evaluating a SaaS application that the human resources department would like to implement. The analyst requests a SOC 2 report from the SaaS vendor. Which of the following processes is the analyst most likely conducting?
questions.explanation: Due diligence memeriksa keamanan vendor sebelum adopsi SaaS. Cakup data, akses, subprocessor, retensi, insiden, serta portabilitas saat keluar.

questions.stem: Which of the following is used to conceal credit card information in a database log file?
questions.explanation: Masking membatasi digit yang tampil dalam log. Pencegahan utama adalah menghindari pencatatan data mentah; tokenization mengubah representasi data di alur proses.

questions.stem: An organization recently started hosting a new service that customers access through a web portal. A security engineer needs to add to the existing security devices a new solution to protect this new service. Which of the following is the engineer most likely to deploy?
questions.explanation: WAF memeriksa dan memfilter HTTP di depan web portal. Firewall jaringan mengatur koneksi, sementara EDR melihat proses host.

questions.stem: Which of the following topics would most likely be included within an organization's SDLC?
questions.explanation: Branch protection menegakkan review dan check pada perubahan kode, jadi termasuk secure SDLC. Tujuan utamanya kualitas dan kendali perubahan sebelum rilis.

questions.stem: Which of the following control types is AUP an example of?
questions.explanation: AUP adalah kontrol managerial karena berupa kebijakan. Berdasarkan fungsi, AUP directive karena mengarahkan perilaku.

questions.stem: An organization is adopting cloud services at a rapid pace and now has multiple SaaS applications in use. Each application has a separate log-in, so the security team wants to reduce the number of credentials each employee must maintain. Which of the following is the first step the security team should take?
questions.explanation: IdP menjadi sumber identitas yang dipercaya dan mengirim bukti autentikasi ke SaaS. SSO adalah pengalaman login lintas aplikasi; federation menghubungkan domain kepercayaan.

questions.stem: A company's online store becomes unavailable shortly after midnight. A security analyst reviews the backup script and finds a date-triggered instruction that deletes the production database. Which of the following should the analyst do next?
options: Review WAF logs for evidence of command injection
Scan the database server for ransomware notes
Scan the web server for ransomware notes
questions.explanation: Kunci mencari bukti command injection di WAF. Pemicu terjadwal juga konsisten dengan perubahan skrip lokal, sehingga cek perubahan file, scheduler dan audit database. Kunci tidak membuktikan penyebab.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best way to test resiliency in the event of a primary power failure?
questions.explanation: Failover yang benar-benar dijalankan menguji apakah layanan berpindah saat sumber daya utama gagal. Tabletop hanya menguji keputusan; uji terencana perlu rollback.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the most appropriate way to protect data in transit?
questions.explanation: TLS 1.3 melindungi komunikasi in transit dengan autentikasi dan enkripsi bila dikonfigurasi tepat. FDE melindungi data at rest.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a common, passive reconnaissance technique employed by penetration testers in the early phases of an engagement?
questions.explanation: OSINT memakai data publik yang sudah tersedia. Passive reconnaissance tidak perlu berinteraksi langsung dengan sistem sasaran.

questions.stem: Which of the following threat actors is the most likely to seek financial gain through the use of ransomware attacks?
questions.explanation: Pemerasan finansial lazim dikaitkan dengan organized crime. Motif dalam asesmen nyata disimpulkan dari bukti yang cukup, bukan jenis malware saja.

questions.stem: Which of the following would a systems administrator follow when upgrading the firmware of an organization’s router?
questions.explanation: Maintenance window menyediakan waktu terjadwal untuk firmware upgrade dan validasi. Backout plan menjelaskan apa yang dilakukan jika upgrade gagal.

questions.stem:
The security team has been asked to only enable host A (10.2.2.7) and host B (10.3.9.9) to the new isolated network segment (10.9.8.14) that provides access to legacy devices.
Access from all other hosts should be blocked. Which of the following entries would need to be added on the firewall?
questions.explanation: C mengizinkan hanya host A 10.2.2.7/32 dan host B 10.3.9.9/32 menuju segmen tujuan, lalu menolak sumber lain. A memakai /24 sehingga mengizinkan seluruh subnet sumber. B menempatkan deny semua sumber sebelum permit sehingga izin berikutnya tidak tercapai. D masih membuka subnet host B dan aturan deny-nya berarah terbalik. /32 menunjuk satu host; /24 mencakup 256 alamat; /27 mencakup 32 alamat. Gambar menulis tujuan 10.9.8.14/27; alamat network kanonis blok tersebut adalah 10.9.8.0/27. Bentuk asli dipertahankan dalam gambar.

questions.stem: A systems administrator needs to ensure the secure communication of sensitive data within the organization’s private cloud. Which of the following is the best choice for the administrator to implement?
questions.explanation: IPsec mengamankan pada lapisan IP, sehingga berlaku untuk trafik antarhost atau jaringan sesuai kebijakan. TLS mengamankan sesi aplikasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following should an internal auditor check for first when conducting an audit of the organization’s risk management program?
questions.explanation: Kebijakan dan prosedur menyediakan kriteria audit. Evidence operasional kemudian menunjukkan apakah proses tersebut diterapkan.

questions.stem: Which of the following activities are associated with vulnerability management? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Prioritization mengurutkan temuan berdasarkan dampak dan exposure. Reporting menyampaikan owner, status dan target; validasi menguji hasil perbaikan.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to perform a risk assessment without using proprietary company information. Which of the following methods should the administrator use to gather information?
questions.explanation: OSINT memberi konteks publik, seperti advisory dan informasi industri. Assessment internal tetap memerlukan bukti terkait aset sendiri.

questions.stem: A systems administrator is concerned about vulnerabilities within cloud computing instances. Which of the following is most important for the administrator to consider when architecting a cloud computing environment?
questions.explanation: VM escape menyeberangi batas guest menuju host atau hypervisor. Isolasi, patch hypervisor dan pembatasan perangkat virtual menurunkan risiko.

questions.stem: A database administrator is updating the company’s SQL database, which stores credit card information for pending purchases. Which of the following is the best method to secure the data against a potential breach?
questions.explanation: Tokenization mengganti nomor kartu dengan token berotorisasi. Masking mengubah tampilan; enkripsi menyandikan nilai yang dapat dikembalikan dengan kunci.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a benefit of vendor diversity?
questions.explanation: Keragaman vendor dapat mengurangi kegagalan serentak karena satu flaw produk. Keragaman meningkatkan kompleksitas serta kebutuhan uji dan operasi.

questions.stem: An employee used a company’s billing system to issue fraudulent checks. The administrator is looking for evidence of other occurrences of this activity. Which of the following should the administrator examine?
questions.explanation: Application log memperlihatkan tindakan pada sistem billing dan objek transaksi. OS log memberi akun atau proses host; gabungkan keduanya bila diperlukan.

questions.stem: An organization is looking to optimize its environment and reduce the number of patches necessary for operating systems. Which of the following will best help to achieve this objective?
questions.explanation: Container berbagi kernel host sehingga tidak perlu OS guest per aplikasi. Patch base image, dependensi dan host tetap perlu.

questions.stem: Which of the following tasks is typically included in the BIA process?
options: Estimating the recovery time of systems
Establishing the backup and recovery procedures
questions.explanation: BIA mengukur dampak downtime, menentukan prioritas dan memberi dasar target pemulihan. DRP merinci tindakan yang memenuhi target tersebut.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a risk of conducting a vulnerability assessment?
questions.explanation: Assessment aktif dapat menambah beban atau mengganggu aset rapuh. Tentukan scope, jadwal, batas pengujian, monitoring dan kondisi berhenti.

questions.stem: Which of the following techniques would attract the attention of a malicious attacker in an insider threat scenario?
options: Creating a false text file in /docs/salaries
questions.explanation: File umpan atau honeyfile menghasilkan event ketika diakses. Honeypot adalah layanan umpan; honeytoken dapat berupa identifier atau kredensial palsu untuk deteksi.

questions.stem: An organization maintains intellectual property that it wants to protect. Which of the following concepts would be most beneficial to add to the company’s security awareness training program?
questions.explanation: Insider detection melihat akses menyimpang terhadap IP organisasi. Least privilege dan DLP juga membantu mengurangi serta memantau paparan.

questions.stem: An organization plans to expand its operations internationally and needs to keep data at the new location secure. The organization wants to use the most secure architecture model possible. Which of the following models offers the highest level of security?
questions.explanation: Hybrid menggabungkan lingkungan lokal dan cloud sehingga workload tertentu dapat dipertahankan di lokasi yang diwajibkan. Lokasi penyimpanan perlu dibuktikan lewat pengaturan dan kontrak.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the most relevant reason a DPO would develop a data inventory?
options: To manage data storage requirements better
To determine the impact in the event of a breach
To extend the lenght of time data can be retained
To automate the reduction of duplicated data
questions.explanation: Data inventory mencatat jenis, lokasi, owner dan aliran data. Informasi ini mempercepat penilaian dampak ketika terjadi breach.

questions.stem: Which of the following cryptographic solutions protects data at rest?
questions.explanation: FDE mengenkripsi disk saat data tersimpan. TLS atau VPN menjaga saat transmisi; hashing membantu verifikasi integritas.

questions.stem: Which of the following should an organization use to protect its environment from external attacks conducted by an unauthorized hacker?
questions.explanation: NIPS melihat trafik jaringan secara inline dan dapat memblokir. NIDS biasanya memantau dan memberi alert; WAF fokus ke web.

questions.stem: Which of the following would enable a data center to remain operational through a multiday power outage?
questions.explanation: Generator mendukung gangguan listrik lebih lama selama bahan bakar dan konektivitas terpenuhi. UPS menjaga daya sementara sampai generator stabil.

questions.stem: A company installed cameras and added signs to alert visitors that they are being recorded. Which of the following controls did the company implement? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Kamera memberi bukti kejadian; papan pemberitahuan membantu memberi efek jera. Kunci memilih detective dan deterrent.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to securely store an encryption key for a data set in a manner that allows multiple entities to access the key when needed?
questions.explanation: Key escrow menjaga salinan kunci yang dapat dipulihkan melalui prosedur berotorisasi. HSM dapat melindungi kunci; escrow menjawab kebutuhan akses pemulihan.

questions.stem: For which of the following reasons would a systems administrator leverage a 3DES hash from an installer file that is posted on a vendor’s website?
options: To test the integrity of the file
To validate the autehnticity of the file
To activate the license for the file
To calculate the checksum of the file
questions.explanation: Tujuan soal adalah integritas melalui digest pembanding. Istilah “3DES hash” di soal keliru karena 3DES adalah cipher; gunakan hash yang sesuai seperti SHA-256.

questions.stem: A company is redesigning its infrastructure and wants to reduce the number of physical servers in use. Which of the following architectures is best suited for this goal?
questions.explanation: Virtualization mengonsolidasikan beberapa guest ke host fisik. Container mengisolasi aplikasi pada kernel bersama; pilihan ditentukan kebutuhan isolasi dan operasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following security concepts is being followed when implementing a product that offers protection against DDoS attacks?
questions.explanation: Jika produk menjaga layanan dapat dipakai saat gangguan, manfaat utamanya availability. Integrity dan confidentiality melindungi properti lain.

questions.stem: A security manager created new documentation to use in response to various types of security incidents. Which of the following is the next step the manager should take?
options: Set the maximum data retention policy
Securely store the documents on an air-gapped network
Review the documents' data classification policy
Conduct a tabletop exercise with the team
questions.explanation: Tabletop membantu tim berlatih peran, eskalasi dan komunikasi menurut dokumen. Uji failover mengukur apakah implementasi teknis benar-benar bekerja.

questions.stem: A company is developing a critical system for the government and storing project information on a fileshare. Which of the following describes how this data will most likely be classified? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Kunci memilih confidential dan restricted karena proyek sensitif dan akses terbatas. Definisi tiap label mengikuti kebijakan klasifikasi organisasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following activities is included in the post-incident review phase?
options: Determining the root cause of the incident
Developing steps to mitigate the risks of the incident
Validating the accuracy of the evidence collected during the investigation
Reestablishing the compromised system's configuration and settings
questions.explanation: Post-incident review menganalisis root cause dan perbaikan sistemik. Tindakan containment atau recovery sudah menjadi bagian penanganan.

questions.stem: Which of the following attacks exploits a potential vulnerability as a result of using weak cryptographic algorithms?
questions.explanation: Algoritma penyimpanan atau parameter yang lemah membuat tebakan password lebih murah. Salt unik, KDF yang sesuai, dan pengamanan database menekan risiko.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a preventive physical security control?
questions.explanation: Bollards menghalangi kendaraan mendekati fasilitas. Kamera mendeteksi; tanda memperingatkan atau memberi efek jera.

questions.stem: Which of the following is most likely to be used as a just-in-time reference document within a security operations center?
questions.explanation: Playbook memuat pemicu, langkah keputusan dan komunikasi untuk skenario tertentu. SOP menjelaskan prosedur baku lebih umum.

questions.stem: A security engineer configured a remote access VPN. The remote access VPN allows end users to connect to the network by using an agent that is installed on the endpoint, which establishes an encrypted tunnel. Which of the following protocols did the engineer most likely implement?
questions.explanation: IPsec memberi tunnel dengan perlindungan pada lapisan IP. Konfigurasi autentikasi, route dan izin menentukan siapa dapat mencapai resource.

questions.stem: Executives at a company are concerned about employees accessing systems and information about sensitive company projects unrelated to the employees’ normal job duties. Which of the following enterprise security capabilities will the security team most likely deploy to detect that activity?
questions.explanation: UBA membandingkan pola perilaku pengguna dengan baseline untuk menemukan anomali. Alert perilaku perlu investigasi dan konteks pekerjaan.

questions.stem: Several customers want an organization to verify its security controls are operating effectively and have requested an independent opinion. Which of the following is the most efficient way to address these requests?
options: Hire a vendor to perform a penetration test
Allow each client the right to audit
questions.explanation: Attestation independen memberi bukti pihak ketiga terhadap kriteria tertentu. Lihat periode, scope, dan kontrol yang dikecualikan.

questions.stem: A university employee logged on to the academic server and attempted to guess the system administrators’ log-in credentials. Which of the following security measures should the university have implemented to detect the employee’s attempts to gain access to the administrators’ accounts?
questions.explanation: User activity log membantu menautkan percobaan akses dengan akun dan waktu. Cocokkan dengan audit autentikasi serta izin aktual.

questions.stem: Which of the following consequences would a retail chain most likely face from customers in the event the retailer is non-compliant with PCI DSS?
questions.explanation: Kehilangan kepercayaan pelanggan adalah reputational damage. Denda bergantung pada kewenangan dan kewajiban, dan berbeda dari respons pelanggan.

questions.stem: A security analyst reviews a web access log and sees that a User-Agent header contains shell-command syntax. The server returned HTTP 200. Which of the following controls best mitigates this type of attack?
questions.explanation: Kunci mengarah ke sanitasi input. Terapkan validasi berbasis format yang diizinkan dan hindari penggunaan masukan tak tepercaya sebagai perintah; log saja belum membuktikan eksekusi.

questions.stem: An administrator is installing an SSL certificate on a new system. During testing, errors indicate that the certificate is not trusted. The administrator has verified with the issuing CA and has validated the private key. Which of the following should the administrator check for next?
options: If the wildcard certificate is configured
If the certificate signing request is valid
If the root certificate is installed
If the public key is configured
questions.explanation: Root CA tepercaya diperlukan untuk memvalidasi rantai. Periksa juga intermediate, nama host, dan masa berlaku sebelum mengubah truststore.

questions.stem: An employee emailed a new systems administrator a malicious web link and convinced the administrator to change the email server’s password. The employee used this access to remove the mailboxes of key personnel. Which of the following security awareness concepts would help prevent this threat in the future?
questions.explanation: Pelatihan mengenali phishing mengajarkan verifikasi link, permintaan tak biasa dan pelaporan ke tim keamanan.

questions.stem: Which of the following strategies should an organization use to efficiently manage and analyze multiple types of logs?
options: Create custom scripts to aggregate and analyze logs
Install a unified threat management appliance
questions.explanation: SIEM menyatukan jenis log, normalisasi field dan korelasi. SOAR mengatur langkah respons; EDR fokus pada endpoint.

questions.stem: A new security regulation was announced that will take effect in the coming year. A company must comply with it to remain in business. Which of the following activities should the company perform next?
questions.explanation: Gap analysis membandingkan kontrol saat ini dengan persyaratan baru dan menghasilkan daftar perbaikan. Audit kemudian menguji bukti pemenuhan.

questions.stem: An accountant is transferring information to a bank over FTP. Which of the following mitigations should the accountant use to protect the confidentiality of the data?
questions.explanation: FTP biasa tidak menjaga isi dan kredensial saat transit. Pilih transfer terenkripsi seperti SFTP atau FTPS sesuai sistem; keduanya protokol berbeda.

questions.stem: An organization has recently decided to implement SSO. The requirements are to leverage access tokens and focus on application authorization rather than user authentication. Which of the following solutions would the engineering team most likely configure?
questions.explanation: OAuth memberi delegasi akses lewat access token. Untuk autentikasi pengguna dan SSO modern biasanya gunakan OIDC di atas OAuth; SAML memakai assertion.

questions.stem: Which of the following would most likely be used by attackers to perform credential harvesting?
questions.explanation: Credential harvesting sering memanipulasi orang agar menyerahkan kredensial. Filter, pelatihan dan MFA tahan phishing mengurangi risiko.

questions.stem: A security engineer would like to enhance the use of automation and orchestration within the SIEM. Which of the following would be the primary benefit of this enhancement?
options: It acts as a workforce multiplier
questions.explanation: Automasi menangani tugas berulang sehingga analis fokus pada keputusan. Workflow penting perlu approval, audit, batas hak dan pengendalian gagal.
CPU dan memori yang sangat tinggi pada lampiran menunjukkan resource consumption. Jumlah koneksi tidak sendiri membuktikan saturasi; periksa throughput dan status autentikasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following data states applies to data that is being actively processed by a database server?
questions.explanation: Data yang aktif diproses adalah in use. At rest mencakup disk dan backup; in transit mencakup data lewat jaringan.

questions.stem: Which of the following architectures is most suitable to provide redundancy for critical business processes?
questions.explanation: Cloud-native mendukung desain elastis serta redundan lewat layanan dan zonasi cloud. Redundansi tetap harus dirancang serta diuji.

questions.stem: After a security incident, a systems administrator asks the company to buy a NAC platform. Which of the following attack surfaces is the systems administrator trying to protect?
questions.explanation: NAC mengontrol siapa atau perangkat apa yang boleh masuk jaringan, termasuk koneksi wired. Jaringan wireless juga dapat memakai kontrol akses sejenis.
Kunci menunjukkan XSS, yaitu konten aktif yang dapat berjalan di browser. SQLi memengaruhi query database; CSRF menyalahgunakan sesi untuk memicu aksi.

questions.stem: An organization issued new laptops to all employees and wants to provide web filtering both in and out of the office without configuring additional access to the network. Which of the following types of web filtering should a systems administrator configure?
questions.explanation: Agent-based filtering mengikuti laptop di luar kantor. Proxy terpusat perlu trafik diarahkan melaluinya; periksa cakupan perangkat remote.

questions.stem: Which of the following should be used to aggregate log data in order to create alerts and detect anomalous activity?
questions.explanation: SIEM mengagregasi dan mengorelasikan event untuk deteksi. Central log storage dapat menyimpan tanpa analitik atau alert yang sama.

questions.stem: Which of the following provides the best protection against unwanted or insecure communications to and from a device?
questions.explanation: Host-based firewall membatasi koneksi masuk dan keluar pada satu perangkat. Network firewall melindungi jalur bersama; EDR melihat perilaku endpoint.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the primary purpose of a service that tracks log-ins and time spent using the service?
questions.explanation: Accounting mencatat login, sesi dan lama penggunaan. Authentication memverifikasi identitas; authorization menetapkan akses.

questions.stem: An employee who was working remotely lost a mobile device containing company data. Which of the following provides the best solution to prevent future data loss?
questions.explanation: MDM dapat mengelola lock, wipe dan enkripsi perangkat. Pengiriman remote action memerlukan kemampuan perangkat menerima perintah.

questions.stem: An IT administrator needs to ensure data retention standards are implemented on an enterprise application. Which of the following describes the administrator’s role?
questions.explanation: Custodian menjalankan aturan retensi pada sistem. Owner atau controller menetapkan kebijakan; subject adalah individu terkait.

questions.stem:
A company plans to secure its systems by:

• Preventing users from sending sensitive data over corporate email
• Restricting access to potentially harmful websites

Which of the following features should the company set up? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: DLP menangani perpindahan data sensitif dan DNS filtering membantu membatasi resolusi nama domain berbahaya. Keduanya bekerja pada titik enforcement berbeda.

questions.stem: A company processes and stores sensitive data on its own systems. Which of the following steps should the company take first to ensure compliance with privacy regulations?
options: Develop and provide training on data protection policies
Create incident response and disaster recovery plans
questions.explanation: Pelatihan menerjemahkan kebijakan ke tindakan pengguna. Gunakan contoh nyata seperti akses, pengiriman, pelaporan dan penghapusan data.

questions.stem: Which of the following cryptographic methods is preferred for securing communications with limited computing resources?
questions.explanation: Symmetric encryption umumnya lebih efisien untuk volume data daripada operasi asymmetric. Sistem hybrid memakai asymmetric untuk membangun trust atau sesi dan symmetric untuk payload.

questions.stem:
A network administrator wants to ensure that network traffic is highly secure while in transit.

Which of the following actions best describes the actions the network administrator should take?
options: Ensure that NAC is enforced on all network segments, and confirm that firewalls have updated policies to block unauthorized traffic.
Ensure only TLS and other encrypted protocols are selected for use on the network, and only permit authorized traffic via secure protocols.
Configure the perimeter IPS to block inbound HTTPS directory traversal traffic, and verify that signatures are updated on a daily basis.
Ensure the EDR software monitors for unauthorized applications that could be used by threat actors, and configure alerts for the security team.
questions.explanation: Enkripsi protokol menjaga kerahasiaan selama transit dan kebijakan akses membatasi trafik yang sah. Nama protokol saja belum cukup tanpa validasi konfigurasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following definitions best describes the concept of log correlation?
options: Combining relevant logs from multiple sources into one location
Searching and processing data to identify patterns of malicious activity
Making a record of the events that occur in the system
Analyzing the log files of the system components
questions.explanation: Correlation menghubungkan event lintas sumber dan waktu agar pola terlihat. Aggregation mengumpulkan; normalization menyamakan format.

questions.stem: An enterprise security team is researching a new security architecture to better protect the company’s networks and applications against the latest cyberthreats. The company has a fully remote workforce. The solution should be highly redundant and enable users to connect to a VPN with an integrated, software-based firewall. Which of the following solutions meets these requirements?
questions.explanation: SASE menggabungkan jaringan dan fungsi keamanan berbasis layanan cloud. ZTNA berfokus pada akses aplikasi; secure web gateway menyaring web.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best way to validate the integrity and availability of a disaster recovery site?
questions.explanation: Simulated failover menguji apakah data bisa dipakai dan layanan benar-benar naik. Tabletop tidak mengukur waktu restore teknis.

questions.stem: Which of the following allows an exploit to go undetected by the operating system?
questions.explanation: Memory injection dapat mengurangi jejak file. Kunci ini tidak menjamin lolos deteksi modern; telemetri proses dan memori tetap relevan.

questions.stem: A malicious insider from the marketing team alters records and transfers company funds to a personal account. Which of the following methods would be the best way to secure company records in the future?
questions.explanation: Permission restrictions membatasi akses transaksi yang tak relevan bagi marketing. Separation of duties menambah kontrol pada persetujuan transaksi.

questions.stem: An organization is required to provide assurance that its controls are properly designed and operating effectively. Which of the following reports will best achieve the objective?
questions.explanation: Independent audit memberi assurance dengan menilai desain dan operasi kontrol terhadap kriteria. Self-assessment berguna sebagai persiapan internal.

questions.stem: A systems administrator successfully configures VPN access to a cloud environment. Which of the following capabilities should the administrator use to best facilitate remote administration?
options: A jump host in the shared services security zone
An SSH server within the corporate LAN
A reverse proxy on the firewall
An MDM solution with conditional access
questions.explanation: Jump host di shared services memberi jalur admin terkontrol setelah VPN. Jangan memberi akses bebas antarzona hanya karena tunnel aktif.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the concept of information being stored outside of its country of origin while still being subject to the laws and requirements of the country of origin?
questions.explanation: Data sovereignty berhubungan dengan hukum yang berlaku terhadap data. Residency menyatakan lokasi data; geolocation policy menilai lokasi akses.

questions.stem: An audit reveals that cardholder database logs are exposing account numbers inappropriately. Which of the following mechanisms would help limit the impact of this error?
questions.explanation: Masking menutup digit sensitif di log. Lebih baik hanya catat atribut yang dibutuhkan dan tinjau apakah data mentah sudah tersebar.

questions.stem: A security analyst attempts to start a company's database server. When the server starts, the analyst receives an error message indicating the database server did not pass authentication. After reviewing and testing the system, the analyst receives confirmation that the server has been compromised and that attackers have redirected all outgoing database traffic to a server under their control. Which of the following MITRE ATT&CK techniques did the attacker most likely use to redirect database traffic?
questions.explanation: Escape to host berarti proses dalam guest atau container menjangkau host. Akses silang antar layanan juga bisa berasal dari salah konfigurasi dan perlu dibuktikan.

questions.stem: A penetration tester enters an office building at the same time as a group of employees despite not having an access badge. Which of the following attack types is the penetration tester performing?
questions.explanation: Tailgating adalah mengikuti orang yang berhak masuk tanpa otorisasi sendiri. Vestibule, badge dan verifikasi petugas mengurangi risikonya.

questions.stem: Which of the following enables the ability to receive a consolidated report from different devices on the network?
questions.explanation: SIEM menyatukan event beberapa perangkat dan menghasilkan laporan. Syslog adalah mekanisme pengiriman log, bukan keseluruhan proses analitik.

questions.stem: Which of the following should an organization focus on the most when making decisions about vulnerability prioritization?
questions.explanation: CVSS terukur untuk membandingkan severity. Untuk keputusan organisasi, gabungkan exposure, jumlah aset, eksploitasi yang diketahui, dan criticality.
