questions.stem: An organization needs to monitor its users’ activities in order to prevent insider threats. Which of the following solutions would help the organization achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: Behavioral analytics mencari deviasi dari baseline pengguna atau entitas. Anomali dapat sah karena perubahan tugas dan perlu konfirmasi.

questions.stem: A customer of a large company receives a phone call from someone claiming to work for the company and asking for the customer’s credit card information. The customer sees the caller ID is the same as the company's main phone number. Which of the following attacks is the customer most likely a target of?
questions.explanation: Voice phishing disebut vishing. Impersonation adalah teknik penyamaran; smishing memakai SMS.

questions.stem: A security analyst is reviewing logs to identify the destination of command-and-control traffic originating from a compromised device within the on-premises network. Which of the following is the best log to review?
questions.explanation: Firewall log memberi informasi tujuan jaringan, waktu dan tindakan. DNS log menambah nama domain; EDR membantu identifikasi proses.

questions.stem: When trying to access an internal website, an employee reports that a prompt displays, stating that the site is insecure. Which of the following certificate types is the site most likely using?
questions.explanation: Sertifikat self-signed tidak otomatis dipercaya browser. Peringatan juga dapat berasal dari masa berlaku, hostname atau chain, sehingga diagnosis tetap perlu detail error.

questions.stem: Which of the following would most likely be deployed to obtain and analyze attacker activity and techniques?
questions.explanation: Honeypot memancing aktivitas pada lingkungan terisolasi agar pola dapat diamati. Perlu pemantauan dan pembatasan egress untuk mencegah dampak ke produksi.

questions.stem: Which of the following objectives is best achieved by a tabletop exercise?
options: Familiarizing participants with the incident response process
Deciding red and blue team rules of engagement
Quickly determining the impact of an actual security breach
Conducting multiple security investigations in parallel
questions.explanation: Tabletop membiasakan peserta dengan alur dan peran incident response melalui diskusi. Functional test memberi bukti eksekusi prosedur.

questions.stem: The private key for a website was stolen, and a new certificate has been issued. Which of the following needs to be updated next?
questions.explanation: Setelah private key bocor, cabut sertifikat terkait dan ganti key pair. CRL menyebarkan status revocation; OCSP memungkinkan pengecekan per sertifikat.

questions.stem: Which of the following organizational documents is most often used to establish and communicate expectations associated with integrity and ethical behavior within an organization?
questions.explanation: AUP menetapkan penggunaan sistem yang diizinkan, sehingga fungsi directive dan kategori managerial. SOP merinci langkah kerja.

questions.stem: Which of the following explains how to determine the global regulations that data is subject to regardless of the country where the data is stored?
questions.explanation: Sovereignty menghubungkan data dengan aturan yurisdiksi yang berlaku. Lokasi fisik penting tetapi bukan satu-satunya faktor penentuan kewajiban.

questions.stem: An organization's web servers host an online ordering system. The organization discovers that the servers are vulnerable to a malicious JavaScript injection, which could allow attackers to access customer payment information. Which of the following mitigation strategies would be most effective for preventing an attack on the organization's web servers? (Choose two.)
options: Regularly updating server software and patches
Encrypting sensitive data at rest and in transit
Removing payment information from the servers
questions.explanation: Patch menutup sumber kelemahan yang diketahui. WAF menambah kontrol HTTP di depan aplikasi; perbaikan kode dan encoding sesuai konteks tetap penting.

questions.stem: Which of the following tools is best for logging and monitoring in a cloud environment?
questions.explanation: SIEM menggabungkan log cloud audit, aplikasi, identitas dan jaringan. Pastikan layanan mengirim sumber event yang diperlukan.

questions.stem: During a SQL update of a database, a temporary field that was created was replaced by an attacker in order to allow access to the system. Which of the following best describes this type of vulnerability?
questions.explanation: Bank memilih malicious update karena perubahan data digunakan untuk akses tak sah. Race condition perlu bukti hasil bergantung urutan atau timing konkurensi, yang belum jelas.

questions.stem: A group of developers has a shared backup account to access the source code repository. Which of the following is best way to secure the backup account if there is an SSO failure?
questions.explanation: PAM mengatur akses privileged yang masih dibutuhkan, termasuk vault, rotasi, dan audit. Jika memungkinkan, gunakan identitas individual pada tugas admin.

questions.stem: Which of the following elements of digital forensics should a company use if it needs to ensure the integrity of evidence?
questions.explanation: Preservation menjaga bukti tetap utuh. Hash membantu membuktikan konsistensi salinan; chain of custody mencatat perpindahan serta pengendalian akses bukti.

questions.stem: A company suffered a critical incident where 30GB of data was exfiltrated from the corporate network. Which of the following actions is the most efficient way to identify where the system data was exfiltrated from and what location the attacker sent the data to?
options: Analyze firewall and network logs for large amounts of outbound traffic to external IP addresses or domains.
Analyze IPS and IDS logs to find the IP addresses used by the attacker for reconnaissance scans.
Analyze endpoint and application logs to see whether file-sharing programs were running on the company systems.
Analyze external vulnerability scans and automated reports to identify the systems the attacker could have exploited a remote code vulnerability.
questions.explanation: Firewall dan flow log membantu menemukan asal, tujuan dan volume egress. Log endpoint atau aplikasi membantu mengidentifikasi proses dan data yang terkait.

questions.stem: Which of the following describes the procedures a penetration tester must follow while conducting a test?
questions.explanation: Rules of engagement menentukan aktivitas, scope, eskalasi, dan jam yang diizinkan. SOW mencatat keluaran kontrak, NDA membatasi pengungkapan.

questions.stem: A security analyst wants to better understand the behavior of users and devices in order to gain visibility into potential malicious activities. The analyst needs a control to detect when actions deviate from a common baseline. Which of the following should the analyst use?
questions.explanation: EDR memberi visibilitas proses, perangkat dan perilaku endpoint. UEBA lebih fokus pada analitik perilaku lintas entitas; SIEM menggabungkan sumber.

questions.stem: A legal department must maintain a backup from all devices that have been shredded and recycled by a third party. Which of the following best describes this requirement?
questions.explanation: Retention menentukan durasi dan perlindungan data yang harus tetap ada meski perangkat fisik dipensiunkan. Legal hold bisa menunda disposal bila relevan.

questions.stem: Which of the following can be used to compromise a system that is running an RTOS?
questions.explanation: Kunci memilih memory injection sebagai risiko perangkat RTOS. Kendali memori, pembaruan vendor dan isolasi membantu sesuai kemampuan perangkat.

questions.stem: Which of the following threat actors would most likely deface the website of a high-profile music group?
questions.explanation: Defacement sederhana dengan motif prestise dapat cocok dengan unskilled attacker menurut soal. Defacement juga bisa ideologis; atribusi memerlukan bukti.

questions.stem: A security architect wants to prevent employees from receiving malicious attachments by email. Which of the following functions should the chosen solution do?
options: Tap and monitor the email feed
questions.explanation: Scanning email inline memeriksa pesan sebelum diterima. EDR mendeteksi eksekusi pada perangkat; awareness menangani pesan yang lolos.

questions.stem: Which of the following activities is the first stage in the incident response process?
questions.explanation: Bank memilih detection sebagai tahap pertama saat insiden mulai ditangani. Preparation terjadi sebelumnya dan termasuk awal lifecycle dalam model lain.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the main consideration when a legacy system that is a critical part of a company's infrastructure cannot be replaced?
questions.explanation: Sistem legacy tunggal bisa menjadi SPOF bila tidak ada pengganti. Identifikasi dependensi, strategi fallback serta jadwal migrasi.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a compensating control for providing user access to a high-risk website?
options: Enabling threat prevention features on the firewall
Configuring a SIEM tool to capture all web traffic
Setting firewall rules to allow traffic from any port to that destination
Blocking that website on the endpoint protection software
questions.explanation: Kontrol firewall menurunkan risiko akses yang tetap diizinkan. Sebagai compensating control, tentukan kondisi, cakupan dan evaluasi terhadap kebutuhan awal.

questions.stem: An organization is implementing a COPE mobile device management policy. Which of the following should the organization include in the COPE policy? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: COPE memakai perangkat milik perusahaan dengan penggunaan pribadi yang diizinkan. Enkripsi menjaga data; wipe merespons kehilangan dan perlu kebijakan scope yang jelas.

questions.stem:
A security administrator observed the following in a web server log while investigating an incident:

"GET ../../../../etc/passwd"

Which of the following attacks did the security administrator most likely see?
questions.explanation: Directory traversal berupaya mengakses file di luar direktori yang diizinkan. Gunakan pembatasan path dan akar penyimpanan yang tervalidasi.

questions.stem: An organization wants a third-party vendor to do a penetration test that targets a specific device. The organization has provided basic information about the device. Which of the following best describes this kind of penetration test?
questions.explanation: Partially known berarti tester diberi sebagian informasi target. Known memberi konteks luas; unknown menilai dari pengetahuan awal minimum dalam scope yang sah.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a security team do first before a new web server goes live?
questions.explanation: Hardening sebelum go-live mengurangi layanan, akses dan konfigurasi lemah. Validasi baseline, patch, log, dan identitas setelah penerapan.

questions.stem: Which of the following techniques can be used to sanitize the data contained on a hard drive while allowing for the hard drive to be repurposed?
questions.explanation: Wiping berupaya menghapus data sambil mempertahankan media untuk reuse. Untuk SSD, pertimbangkan metode purge atau secure erase yang didukung vendor dan verifikasi.

questions.stem: An attacker submits a request containing unexpected characters in an attempt to gain unauthorized access to information within the underlying systems. Which of the following best describes this attack?
questions.explanation: SQL injection memengaruhi arti query. Karakter tak terduga saja belum membuktikan exploit berhasil; gunakan parameterized queries dan logging aman.

questions.stem: A security analyst has determined that a security breach would have a financial impact of $15,000 and is expected to occur twice within a three-year period. Which of the following is the ALE for this risk?
questions.explanation: Kunci menghitung ALE sebesar sekitar US$10.000 per tahun dari dampak US$15.000 dikali frekuensi tahunan sekitar 0,67. Pastikan satuan frekuensi dinormalisasi.

questions.stem: A systems administrator discovers a system that is no longer receiving support from the vendor. However, this system and its environment are critical to running the business, cannot be modified, and must stay online. Which of the following risk treatments is the most appropriate in this situation?
questions.explanation: Transfer mengalihkan sebagian dampak atau tanggung jawab melalui pihak lain sesuai perjanjian. Mitigasi tetap diperlukan jika risiko residual signifikan.

questions.stem: A company discovered its data was advertised for sale on the dark web. During the initial investigation, the company determined the data was proprietary data. Which of the following is the next step the company should take?
options: Report the breach to the local authorities
Notify the applicable parties of the breach
Implement vulnerability scanning of the company's systems
questions.explanation: Bank memilih pelaporan ke otoritas setempat. Dalam praktik, eskalasi ke legal dan tim IR serta ikuti kewajiban notifikasi yang benar untuk yurisdiksi dan data.

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best solution to deploy a low-cost standby site that includes hardware and internet access?
questions.explanation: Hardware dan akses internet sudah tersedia menunjukkan warm site. Cold menyediakan ruang dan infrastruktur dasar; hot siap pindah lebih cepat.

questions.stem: An organization needs to determine how many employees are accessing the building each day in order to configure the proper access controls. Which of the following control types best meets this requirement?
questions.explanation: Menghitung siapa yang telah masuk melalui log badge adalah detective. Menolak badge tanpa hak akses adalah fungsi preventive.

questions.stem: An organization wants to implement a secure solution for remote users. The users handle sensitive PHI on a regular basis and need to access an internally developed corporate application. Which of the following best meet the organization's security requirements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: VPN melindungi kanal remote dan MFA meningkatkan kepastian identitas. Data sensitif di endpoint juga perlu enkripsi, posture serta izin yang tepat.

questions.stem: A security officer is implementing a security awareness program and is placing security-themed posters around the building and is assigning online user training. Which of the following would the security officer most likely implement?
questions.explanation: Phishing campaign latihan memberi feedback perilaku pengguna. Poster menjadi pengingat; latihan mengukur respons nyata dan pelaporan.

questions.stem: A security consultant is working with a client that wants to physically isolate its secure systems. Which of the following best describes this architecture?
questions.explanation: Air gap memisahkan sistem secara fisik dari jaringan lain. Segmentasi logis tetap mengandalkan aturan antarsegmen dan konektivitas yang ada.

questions.stem: A company is in the process of migrating to cloud-based services. The company’s IT department has limited resources for migration and ongoing support. Which of the following best meets the company’s needs?
questions.explanation: SASE menyediakan akses jaringan dan inspeksi melalui layanan cloud. Tim masih perlu mengelola kebijakan, identitas, logging dan vendor.

questions.stem: An employee clicks a malicious link in an email that appears to be from the company's Chief Executive Officer. The employee's computer is infected with ransomware that encrypts the company's files. Which of the following is the most effective way for the company to prevent similar incidents in the future?
questions.explanation: Pelatihan membantu pengguna memverifikasi permintaan CEO dan melaporkan link. Gateway email dan MFA mengurangi paparan serta konsekuensi.

questions.stem: Which of the following types of vulnerabilities is primarily caused by improper use and management of cryptographic certificates?
questions.explanation: Insecure key storage dapat membuka semua data yang bergantung pada kunci itu. Gunakan penyimpanan kunci dengan akses minimum, rotasi dan audit.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describe the benefits of a microservices architecture when compared to a monolithic architecture? (Choose two.)
options: Reduced cost of ownership of the system
questions.explanation: Layanan bisa diskalakan terpisah, dan compartmentalization mengecilkan dampak failure jika batasnya benar. Konsekuensinya dependensi jaringan, observabilitas dan operasi lebih kompleks.

questions.stem: A user's workstation becomes unresponsive and displays a ransom note demanding payment to decrypt files. Before the attack, the user opened a resume they received in a message, browsed the company's website, and installed OS updates. Which of the following is the most likely vector of this attack?
questions.explanation: Watering hole menunjuk sumber paparan melalui situs yang biasa dikunjungi. Ransomware menunjuk dampak atau jenis malware pada workstation.

questions.stem: A penetration tester finds an unused Ethernet port during an on-site penetration test. Upon plugging a device into the unused port, the penetration tester notices that the machine is assigned an IP address, allowing the tester to enumerate the local network. Which of the following should an administrator implement in order to prevent this situation from happening in the future?
questions.explanation: Port security membatasi perangkat yang bisa menggunakan jack Ethernet. Nonaktifkan port kosong dan pakai 802.1X bila tersedia.

questions.stem: Which of the following should be used to ensure an attacker is unable to read the contents of a mobile device's drive if the device is lost?
questions.explanation: FDE membuat data media sulit dibaca ketika perangkat terkunci atau mati. MDM dan remote wipe melengkapi respons kehilangan.
Kunci menunjuk DNS poisoning dari data lampiran. Fokus pada hasil resolusi yang menyimpang dari catatan tepercaya; DDoS lebih terkait volume dan ketersediaan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the primary reason why false negatives on a vulnerability scan should be a concern?
options: The system has vulnerabilities that are not being detected.
The time to remediate vulnerabilities that do not exist is excessive.
Vulnerabilities with a lower severity will be prioritized over critical vulnerabilities.
The system has vulnerabilities, and a patch has not yet been released.
questions.explanation: False negative melewatkan kelemahan yang nyata. Credentialed testing, coverage review dan validasi manual meningkatkan keyakinan hasil.

questions.stem: A company is concerned about theft of client data from decommissioned laptops. Which of the following is the most cost-effective method to decrease this risk?
questions.explanation: Wiping menghapus data pada laptop yang akan dipensiunkan atau dipakai ulang. Metode ditentukan oleh jenis media serta kebutuhan bukti disposal.

questions.stem: A company that has a large IT operation is looking to better control, standardize, and lower the time required to build new servers. Which of the following architectures will best achieve the company’s objectives?
questions.explanation: IaC mempercepat provisioning dan menyeragamkan konfigurasi melalui version control. Drift detection dan review menunjukkan apakah keadaan aktual sesuai deklarasi.

questions.stem: A government official receives a blank envelope containing photos and a note instructing the official to wire a large sum of money by midnight to prevent the photos from being leaked on the internet. Which of the following best describes the threat actor's intent?
questions.explanation: Ancaman menyebarkan informasi agar korban menuruti permintaan adalah blackmail. Berbeda dari impersonation yang bergantung pada identitas palsu.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best security reason for closing service ports that are not needed?
options: To mitigate risks associated with unencrypted traffic
To eliminate false positives from a vulnerability scan
To reduce a system's attack surface
To improve a system's resource utilization
questions.explanation: Layanan yang tidak diperlukan menambah jalur serang. Menonaktifkannya mengurangi attack surface; inventaris dan pengujian mencegah gangguan pada dependensi sah.

questions.stem: Which of the following would a security administrator use to comply with a secure baseline during a patch update?
questions.explanation: SOP membuat patching konsisten dengan baseline lewat langkah terdokumentasi. Change request dan hasil verifikasi membuktikan penerapan.

questions.stem: A malicious actor conducted a brute-force attack on a company's web servers and eventually gained access to the company's customer information database. Which of the following is the most effective way to prevent similar attacks?
questions.explanation: WAF bisa membatasi pola brute force pada login HTTP. Rate limiting, deteksi login anomali dan MFA melengkapi kontrol; WAF tidak mencakup semua protokol.

questions.stem: Which of the following options will provide the lowest RTO and RPO for a database?
questions.explanation: Journaling mencatat perubahan untuk replay setelah base backup, sehingga dapat mendukung titik pemulihan yang rapat. Hot site meningkatkan kesiapan lokasi; RPO database tetap bergantung pada replikasi atau backup. RTO aktual diukur lewat uji restore.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a possible consequence of a VM escape?
options: Malicious instructions can be inserted into memory and give the attacker elevated permissions.
An attacker can access the hypervisor and compromise other VMs.
Unencrypted data can be read by a user who is in a separate environment.
Users can install software that is not on the manufacturer’s approved list.
questions.explanation: VM escape bisa memberi akses ke hypervisor dan mengancam guest lain. Patch host, isolasi dan pembatasan manajemen menurunkan cakupannya.

questions.stem: A security team at a large, global company needs to reduce the cost of storing data used for performing investigations. Which of the following types of data should have its retention length reduced?
questions.explanation: Full packet capture biasanya membutuhkan kapasitas besar. Metadata flow dan sampling dapat menghemat ruang; tentukan retensi dan bukti yang masih diperlukan.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of vulnerability that involves inserting scripts into web-based applications in order to take control of the client's web browser?
questions.explanation: XSS memasukkan konten aktif yang dapat dijalankan browser. SQLi mengenai query, CSRF mengenai aksi pada sesi valid.

questions.stem: During an investigation, an analyst finds an HTTP request whose search parameter includes SQL syntax attempting to insert a user account. The server returned HTTP 200. Which of the following should the analyst do first?
options: Block brute-force attempts on temporary users
Check the users table for new accounts
questions.explanation: Periksa bukti state aplikasi dan audit data untuk melihat apakah permintaan mencurigakan benar-benar menghasilkan akun. HTTP 200 membuktikan status respons, bukan perubahan data.

questions.stem: Due to a cyberattack, a company's IT systems were not operational for an extended period of time. The company wants to measure how quickly the systems must be restored in order to minimize business disruption. Which of the following would the company most likely use?
questions.explanation: RTO menghitung batas waktu hingga layanan kembali. RPO mengukur data yang boleh hilang, dan MTBF berkaitan dengan jarak antar kegagalan.

questions.stem: Which of the following actors attacking an organization is the most likely to be motivated by personal beliefs?
questions.explanation: Hacktivist biasanya didorong keyakinan atau isu ideologis. Organized crime menonjolkan profit dan nation-state tujuan strategis.

questions.stem: Which of the following should a security team use to document persistent vulnerabilities with related recommendations?
questions.explanation: Risk register menyimpan risiko persisten, owner, tindakan dan status. Output scanner mendukung bukti teknis; register menghubungkannya dengan keputusan.

questions.stem: An organization purchased a critical business application containing sensitive data. The organization would like to ensure that the application is not exploited by common data exfiltration attacks. Which of the following approaches would best help to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanation: WAF dapat memberi virtual patch pada trafik HTTP aplikasi yang tidak bisa segera diubah. Periksa cakupan dan rencana patch tetap.

questions.stem: A company wants to improve the availability of its application with a solution that requires minimal effort in the event a server needs to be replaced or added. Which of the following would be the best solution to meet these objectives?
questions.explanation: Load balancing mengalihkan trafik ke instance sehat dan cocok jika beberapa instance bisa disediakan. Dependensi stateful tetap perlu strategi redundansi.
